docs.title: Composition
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • 133 spliceable techniques for Composition
  • Still mode clause; I2V include False
  • 0 muted 5s illustration clips shipped
  • Ids for the Cinema Rack combo (pick one per axis)

What this enables

  • Picking a professional cinematography clause instead of guessing camera language
  • Opening a technique page to watch a 5s example when the clip is shipped
  • Seeing conflicts, still/motion/AV flags, and the Wan token when present

Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_cinema_docs.py. Operator playbook: Cinema Rack.

Id Label Example Clause Use on Conflicts cmp_thirds_right Thirds right — Park the subject on the right vertical third with looking room to the left. still, motion, av — cmp_thirds_left Thirds left — Park the subject on the left vertical third with looking room to the right. still, motion, av — cmp_thirds_upper Thirds upper — Pin eyes on the upper horizontal third so the lower frame holds body or ground. still, motion, av — cmp_thirds_lower Thirds lower — Sit the figure on the lower third so sky or ceiling dominates the top two-thirds. still, motion, av — cmp_center_punch Center punch — Bullseye the face dead center, symmetry of the room echoing both sides. still, motion, av — cmp_center_vertical Center axis vertical — Hold the body on the vertical midline of a 9:16 plate, depth receding behind. still, motion, av — cmp_short_side Short side — Short-side the look: eyes close to the frame edge they face, tension in the leftover air. still, motion, av — cmp_long_side Long side — Give generous looking room so the gaze travels across empty architecture. still, motion, av — cmp_diagonal Diagonal — Build a diagonal from lower left ground to upper right face, energy climbing the frame. still, motion, av — cmp_counter_diagonal Counter diagonal — Slash a diagonal from upper left lamp to lower right hands. still, motion, av — cmp_leading_road Leading road — Let a road, rail, or corridor lines suck the eye to a small figure. still, motion, av — cmp_leading_hands Leading hands — Use outstretched arms or a pointed tool as a vector into the face. still, motion, av — cmp_vanishing Vanishing point — Place the subject at a one-point vanishing point of a hall or nave. still, motion, av — cmp_two_point Two-point — Stand a building on two-point perspective, verticals true, mass on the near corner. still, motion, av — cmp_frame_in_frame Frame in frame — Shoot through a doorway, window, or arch so a second rectangle cages the person. still, motion, av — cmp_dirty_fg Dirty foreground — Hang an out-of-focus shoulder, plant, or glass in the near field, subject readable beyond. still, motion, av — cmp_clean_graphic Clean graphic — Empty the near field, subject against a simple wall or sky, poster-flat. still, motion, av — cmp_layers_three Three planes — Occupy foreground, mid, and far with distinct masses so depth is stacked. still, motion, av — cmp_negative_left Negative left — Leave the left two-thirds empty so a small figure on the right feels isolated. still, motion, av — cmp_negative_top Negative top — Crush the figure to the bottom with a huge empty sky or ceiling. still, motion, av — cmp_figure_ground Figure ground — Cut a sharp silhouette against a much brighter or darker field. still, motion, av — cmp_isolation Isolation — Float one person in a huge readable place, tiny in the geography. still, motion, av — cmp_cluster Cluster — Pack a group into one dense knot, leftover frame empty. still, motion, av — cmp_pattern_break Pattern break — Repeat a rhythm of windows or trees, then break it with the subject. still, motion, av — cmp_repetition Repetition — March identical objects across the frame so the eye counts them. still, motion, av — cmp_juxtapose_scale Scale juxtapose — Stand a small person against a huge unmarked machine or facade. still, motion, av — cmp_overlap Overlapping forms — Overlap bodies and furniture so nearer shapes hide farther ones. still, motion, av — cmp_aerial_perspective Aerial perspective — Let distant planes go cooler and softer while the near subject stays crisp. still, motion, av — cmp_size_diminution Size diminution — Same object type near and far, the far one tiny, proving distance. still, motion, av — cmp_tele_stack Telephoto stack — Compress a crowd or street into a flat stack of overlapping faces. still, motion, av — cmp_wide_near_far Wide near far — A huge near object and a tiny far figure in one ultra-wide plate. still, motion, av — cmp_formal_balance Formal balance — Mirror masses left and right of a central axis. still, motion, av — cmp_informal_balance Informal balance — A large dark mass on one side answered by a small bright practical on the other. still, motion, av — cmp_radial Radial — Arrange lines and gazes as spokes into a central face. still, motion, av — cmp_triangle Triangle block — Block three heads or lamps as a stable triangle. still, motion, av — cmp_sit_stand Sit stand contrast — One seated, one standing, heights arguing in the same frame. still, motion, av — cmp_enter_left Enter from left — Leave left-edge air so a body can enter from that wing. still, motion, av — cmp_exit_right Exit right — Aim the walk at the right edge with space to leave. still, motion, av — cmp_cross_frame Cross frame — A walker crosses the entire width, path parallel to the sensor. still, motion, av — cmp_toward_lens Toward lens — The subject walks straight at the glass, growing. still, motion, av — cmp_away_lens Away from lens — The subject recedes down a path, shrinking. still, motion, av — cmp_headroom_tight Tight headroom — Hair nearly kisses the top edge, no wasted sky. still, motion, av — cmp_headroom_open Open headroom — Generous air above the crown, a vertical 9:16 that can take captions later in edit not in-camera. still, motion, av — cmp_ground_plane Ground plane — Show a lot of floor so the body is planted, not floating. still, motion, av — cmp_ceiling_crush Ceiling crush — A low ceiling presses down, the head close to architecture. still, motion, av — cmp_s_curve S-curve — A river, path, or body traces an S that the eye follows into depth. still, motion, av — cmp_golden_triangle Golden triangle — A diagonal divide with a perpendicular from the opposite corner, subject at the intersection. still, motion, av — cmp_fibonacci_curve Attention spiral — Compose so the eye spirals from a near object into the face. still, motion, av — cmp_look_space Look space — More air in the direction of the gaze than behind the head. still, motion, av — cmp_over_shoulder_dirty Dirty over-shoulder — A cheek and ear as a dark mass, the far face sharp in the remaining window. still, motion, av — cmp_profile_line Profile line — A full profile against a simple field, the nose pointing into space. still, motion, av — cmp_top_heavy Top heavy — Mass and detail in the upper third, the lower frame quiet. still, motion, av — cmp_bottom_heavy Bottom heavy — Furniture and body weight the lower frame, sky simple. still, motion, av — cmp_left_weight Left weight — Almost all mass on the left, the right a field of tone. still, motion, av — cmp_right_weight Right weight — Almost all mass on the right, the left a field of tone. still, motion, av — cmp_corner_subject Corner subject — Tuck the person in a corner of the frame, architecture claiming the rest. still, motion, av — cmp_edge_slice Edge slice — Crop a face or object with the frame edge as a knife, part of it missing. still, motion, av — cmp_amputate_avoid Joint-safe crop — Crop mid-torso or mid-thigh, never through a joint. still, motion, av — cmp_full_body_grounded Full body grounded — Head to shoes with floor visible, the person entirely in the world. still, motion, av — cmp_insert_hands_center Hands center — Hands and object dead center, face out. still, motion, av — cmp_product_hero_center Product hero — A product on the optical axis, negative space a seamless field. still, motion, av — cmp_rule_of_odds Odds — Group three lamps or three people, not two, so the eye rests on the middle. still, motion, av — cmp_even_pair Even pair — Two equal figures, a 50/50 split of the frame. still, motion, av — cmp_crowd_flow Crowd flow — Bodies as a current, one readable face against the stream. still, motion, av — cmp_window_light_side Window as frame — The window rectangle is the composition, the person a mass inside it. still, motion, av — cmp_mirror_split Mirror split — Half real, half reflection, a vertical join down the glass. still, motion, av — cmp_reflection_puddle Puddle double — A puddle doubles the world, the real figure standing on the join. still, motion, av — cmp_silhouette_arch Silhouette in arch — A dark figure in a bright arch, the arch the only geometry. still, motion, av — cmp_color_mass Color mass — A large field of one hue balanced by a small complementary accent on the subject. still, motion, av — cmp_high_horizon High horizon — Horizon near the top, a lot of ground, the person walking a map. still, motion, av — cmp_low_horizon Low horizon — Horizon near the bottom, a lot of sky, the person a notch on the earth-line. still, motion, av — cmp_no_horizon No horizon — Deny the horizon: a wall, fog, or canopy so scale is uncertain. still, motion, av — cmp_dutch_compose Canted masses — The composition itself is a tilt: floors and lamps as diagonals. still, motion, av — cmp_nested_rectangles Nested rectangles — Picture frames, screens, and doors as rectangles inside rectangles. still, motion, av — cmp_circle_motif Circle motif — Wheels, lamps, or arches as repeating circles around a face. still, motion, av — cmp_verticals_only Verticals only — A forest of verticals, almost no horizontals, the person a vertical too. still, motion, av — cmp_horizontals_only Horizontals only — Layers of land, water, cloud as stacked bands, a small figure on one band. still, motion, av — cmp_grid Grid — A facade or tiles as a grid, the subject breaking one cell. still, motion, av — cmp_empty_center Empty center — Action on the edges, the middle a void the eye keeps returning to. still, motion, av — cmp_busy_center Busy center — All detail in the middle, edges fall to tone. still, motion, av — cmp_occluder_left Left occluder — A dark vertical mass on the left, the scene opening to the right. still, motion, av — cmp_occluder_right Right occluder — A dark vertical mass on the right, the scene opening to the left. still, motion, av — cmp_over_table Over table — Tabletop as a foreground plane, faces beyond the glasses. still, motion, av — cmp_under_object Under object — Look under a table or car so the underside is a ceiling. still, motion, av — cmp_through_crowd Through crowd — Bodies as a broken screen, one far face in a gap. still, motion, av — cmp_power_low Power from below — Compose so the subject towers, the camera and masses looking up. still, motion, av — cmp_power_high Power from above — Compose so the subject is looked down on, the ground a map around them. still, motion, av — cmp_equal_eyeline Equal eyeline — Camera and subject share height, neither dominates. still, motion, av — cmp_caption_safe_vert Caption-safe vertical — Keep the lower fifth and upper fifth free of faces so later text can sit there, faces in the middle band. still, motion, av — cmp_lower_third_clear Lower-third clear — Keep the bottom fifth empty of important mass for a later graphic, not burned in. still, motion, av — cmp_square_center Square center — A 1:1 plate with the subject centered and corners quiet. still, motion, av — cmp_scope_empty_sides Scope side room — A 2.39 plate with huge side room, the figure a small event in width. still, motion, av — cmp_academy_tight Academy tight — A 1.85 plate filled edge to edge with the conversation. still, motion, av — cmp_ig_vertical_head Tall headroom portrait — A 4:5 plate with extra air above the crown and a full torso. still, motion, av — cmp_wide_lower_safe 16:9 lower safe — A 16:9 plate with the face in the upper half, lower half a quiet set. still, motion, av — cmp_split_left_right Split left right — A vertical line (door, wall, light cut) divides two worlds in one frame. still, motion, av — cmp_split_up_down Split up down — A horizon or railing splits the frame into two stacked stories. still, motion, av — cmp_tiny_in_door Tiny in door — A far figure in a distant doorway, the room huge around the dark rectangle. still, motion, av — cmp_fill_the_glass Fill the glass — The face or product fills so much of the frame that context is only edges. still, motion, av — cmp_environmental Environmental — The place is the story, the person a detail of furniture scale. still, motion, av — cmp_over_shoulder_clean Clean single after OTS — No foreground cheek, a clean single that still feels like coverage of a pair. still, motion, av — cmp_group_wedge Group wedge — A wedge of people pointing at one speaker. still, motion, av — cmp_circle_around Circle around — Bodies in a ring, camera outside looking in, or inside looking out. still, motion, av — cmp_procession_line Procession line — A line of people receding, each head a bead. still, motion, av — cmp_one_against_many One against many — A single distinct costume or stance against a uniform crowd. still, motion, av — cmp_table_symmetry Table symmetry — A long table as a centerline, faces in pairs. still, motion, av — cmp_stair_zigzag Stair zigzag — A staircase as a zigzag graphic the figure climbs. still, motion, av — cmp_bridge_span Bridge span — A span as a horizontal bar, a small walker on it. still, motion, av — cmp_window_grid_face Window grid face — A face behind a grid of panes, one pane owning the eyes. still, motion, av — cmp_rain_streak_lines Rain as lines — Rain streaks as composition lines leading to the figure. still, motion, av — cmp_shadow_as_mass Shadow as mass — A cast shadow is a second character occupying a third of the frame. still, motion, av — cmp_practical_as_anchor Practical as anchor — A lamp or neon is the compositional anchor the face answers. still, motion, av — cmp_hands_in_lower Hands in lower third — Story in the hands, face in the upper, a split of labor in one still. still, motion, av — cmp_eyes_on_third_cross Eyes on the cross — Eyes sit exactly on a thirds intersection, the rest of the face falling away. still, motion, av — cmp_profile_into_dark Profile into dark — A profile looking into a dark half, the lit half behind them. still, motion, av — cmp_back_to_camera Back to camera — We see the back, the world they face, the face withheld. still, motion, av — cmp_over_the_hill Over the hill — A ridge as a graphic, a small figure just breaking the skyline. still, motion, av — cmp_tunnel_mouth Tunnel mouth — The tunnel is a dark rectangle, the exit a bright postage stamp with a body in it. still, motion, av — cmp_crowd_part_center Parted crowd — A path through bodies, the far person centered in the gap. still, motion, av — cmp_desk_planes Desk planes — Desktop, mid wall, far window as three parallel planes. still, motion, av — cmp_book_aisle Book aisle — Two walls of unmarked shelves as leading planes, a figure at the vanishing point. still, motion, av — cmp_balcony_down Balcony down — A railing as a near horizontal, the floor below a second composition. still, motion, av — cmp_mezzanine_split Mezzanine split — Upper walkway and lower hall in one frame, two scales of people. still, motion, av — cmp_door_threshold Threshold split — Interior warm and exterior cool meet at a jamb, the person on the line. still, motion, av — cmp_phone_center_axis Phone center axis — Vertical centerline composition for a handheld 9:16, subject on the spine of the glass. still, motion, av — cmp_z_axis_stack Z-axis stack — Near object, subject, far city stacked on the lens axis, not spread sideways. still, motion, av — cmp_empty_chair Empty chair — An empty chair as a composed mass implying a missing person. still, motion, av — cmp_occupied_and_empty Occupied and empty — One side of a sofa lived-in, the other a blank cushion. still, motion, av — cmp_clock_as_circle Clock as circle — A round clock or fan as the only circle in a rectangular room, drawing the eye. still, motion, av — cmp_stripe_rhythm Stripe rhythm — Blinds, siding, or a crosswalk as stripes the figure interrupts. still, motion, av — cmp_corner_escape Corner escape — The subject in a corner with one exit path visible, the other wall a trap. still, motion, av — cmp_open_landscape_tiny Open landscape tiny — A vast readable place, the person a speck with a clear stance. still, motion, av — cmp_claustrophobic_fill Claustrophobic fill — Walls, ceiling, and furniture leave almost no air around the body. still, motion, av —

docs.title: Editing and Transitions
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • 154 spliceable techniques for Editing and Transitions
  • Still mode omit; I2V include True
  • 0 muted 5s illustration clips shipped
  • Ids for the Cinema Rack combo (pick one per axis)

What this enables

  • Picking a professional cinematography clause instead of guessing camera language
  • Opening a technique page to watch a 5s example when the clip is shipped
  • Seeing conflicts, still/motion/AV flags, and the Wan token when present

Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_cinema_docs.py. Operator playbook: Cinema Rack.

Id Label Example Clause Use on Conflicts edt_hard_cut Hard Cut — Make a hard cut from the whisper to the slammed door, picture and room changing on the same frame. motion, av — edt_smash_cut Smash Cut — Smash-cut from the silent chapel to the roaring engine, a violent join of opposites. motion, av — edt_match_action Match On Action — Match-cut on action so the pour begun in the kitchen finishes in the dining room without a skip. motion, av — edt_match_form Match On Form — Match on form so a round clock face becomes a round tunnel mouth. motion, av — edt_match_color Match On Color — Match on color so a red coat exits into a red neon wall as if dye continued. motion, av — edt_graphic_match Graphic Match — Graphic-match a window grid to a crossword, lines continuing across the join. motion, av — edt_match_cut Match Cut — Make a match cut from the spinning fan to the spinning wheel so shape and energy continue. motion, av — edt_eyeline Eyeline Cut — Cut on eyeline so we see what they see after the glance lands. motion, av — edt_shot_reverse Shot Reverse Shot — Play shot/reverse shot across the table, each speaker getting the answering angle. motion, av — edt_insert Insert Cut — Cut to an insert of the unmarked envelope, then return to the face that opened it. motion, av — edt_cutaway Cutaway — Cutaway to the dog in the doorway, then back to the argument. motion, av — edt_cross_cut Cross Cut — Cross-cut the burglar and the sleeper so both clocks feel like one fuse. motion, av — edt_parallel Parallel Action — Run parallel action between the two streets, cutting to keep both arrivals alive. motion, av — edt_jump_cut Jump Cut — Jump-cut inside the same setup so the speaker hops a few inches as if minutes dropped. motion, av — edt_axial_punch Axial Punch In — Axial-punch in along the lens axis, same angle tighter, no new side of the room. motion, av — edt_l_cut L Cut — Hold the outgoing picture while audio continues from the next scene under the last image. motion, av — edt_j_cut J Cut — Let incoming sound lead so the next scene's audio starts under the current picture, then join the picture. motion, av — edt_audio_cuts Audio Cuts With Picture — Cut picture and sound together so audio cuts dead on the join, no tail and no lead. motion, av — edt_cut_on_beat Cut On Beat — Cut on the beat of the diegetic drum, picture changing with the hit, no score. motion, av — edt_cut_on_blink Cut On Blink — Cut on the blink so the lid closing hides the join to the next angle. motion, av — edt_cut_on_door Cut On Door — Cut on the door closing so the slam hides the scene change. motion, av — edt_cut_on_switch Cut On Light Switch — Cut on the light switch so the room going dark becomes the next interior. motion, av — edt_fade_in Fade In — Fade in from black into the street, exposure arriving with the first footsteps. motion, av — edt_fade_out Fade Out — Fade out to black from the last look, sound thinning with the picture. motion, av — edt_dip_black Dip To Black — Dip to black between scenes, a brief dead frame, then up on the new room. motion, av — edt_dip_white Dip To White — Dip to white on the window blast, then down onto the hospital bed. motion, av — edt_cross_dissolve Cross Dissolve — Cross-dissolve the kitchen into the train window so one space melts through the other. motion, av — edt_ripple Ripple Dissolve — Ripple-dissolve into the memory, the pond of the present becoming the past room. motion, av — edt_defocus_through Defocus Through — Defocus-through the join, the first image going to cream then the next sharpening out of it. motion, av — edt_blur_through Blur Through — Blur-through the transition, a smear of travel becoming the new street. motion, av — edt_light_bloom_through Light Bloom Through — Bloom through a blown window into the next scene, white eating then revealing. motion, av — edt_whip_through Whip Through — Whip-through the join, a pan smear becoming the new angle on the other side. motion, av — edt_smash_zoom_through Smash Zoom Through — Smash-zoom through the join, magnification eating the first face and spitting out the next room. motion, av — edt_morph_cut Morph Cut — Morph-cut between two faces so features melt into the next identity. av — edt_linear_wipe Linear Wipe — Linear-wipe a bar across the plate, the new scene arriving behind a traveling edge. motion, av — edt_iris_wipe Iris Wipe — Iris-wipe closed on the first scene and open on the next, a circle handing time. motion, av — edt_clock_wipe Clock Wipe — Clock-wipe like a hand around a dial so the new scene is revealed in a sweep of hours. motion, av — edt_match_wipe_object Match Wipe On Object — Match-wipe on a moving object so a passing truck is both wiper and new scene. motion, av — edt_fg_wipe_by Foreground Wipe By — Let a foreground passerby wipe the lens, the far side of the shoulder a new composition. motion, av — edt_camera_pass_wipe Camera Pass Wipe — Wipe by passing the camera so close to a wall that the dark is the join to another place. motion, av — edt_smash_to_insert Smash Cut To Insert — Smash-cut to an insert of the unmarked key, then smash back to the face that found it. motion, av — edt_jump_time_skip Jump Cut Time Skip — Jump-cut a time skip in the same room so clothes and daylight have changed without a dissolve. motion, av — edt_montage_three Three Beat Montage — Montage three beats—pack, platform, arrival—compressing the journey into three hits. motion, av — edt_invisible_occluder Invisible Cut On Occluder — Hide an invisible cut on an occluder, a column or truck filling the plate as the seam. motion, av — edt_match_gesture Match On Gesture — Match on gesture so a raised hand in one room becomes a raised hand in another. motion, av — edt_cut_on_look Cut On Look — Cut on the look, the turn of the head triggering the next angle. motion, av — edt_cut_on_sound Cut On World Sound — Cut on world SFX—the glass breaking—picture changing with that sound, no score. motion, av — edt_cut_on_clap Cut On Clap — Cut on the clap so palms meeting hide the join to the next setup. motion, av — edt_cut_on_footfall Cut On Footfall — Cut on a footfall, the heel hitting as the angle changes down the hall. motion, av — edt_cut_on_kiss Cut On Kiss — Cut on the kiss, lips meeting as the angle jumps to the two-shot. motion, av — edt_cut_on_laugh Cut On Laugh — Cut on the laugh so the burst of breath hides a new side of the table. motion, av — edt_reaction_cut Reaction Cut — Cut to the reaction before we see the cause, the face arriving ahead of the event. motion, av — edt_pov_cut POV Cut — Cut from the looker to a true POV of their hands on the unmarked rail. motion, av — edt_reverse_angle Reverse Angle — Cut to the reverse angle across the axis, the window now behind the listener. motion, av — edt_thirty_degree Thirty Degree Rule — Obey a thirty-degree change between cuts so the join does not jump-stutter the same setup. motion, av — edt_keep_180 Keep The Line — Keep the 180-degree line so screen direction of the walk stays honest across cuts. motion, av — edt_break_180 Break The Line — Break the 180-degree line on purpose so the chase suddenly feels turned around. motion, av — edt_cut_in Cut In Closer — Cut in closer on the hands without changing angle family, a tighter chapter of the same job. motion, av — edt_cut_out_wide Cut Out Wide — Cut out wide so the private face becomes a small figure in the hall. motion, av — edt_establisher Establisher Cut — Open on an establisher of the unmarked tower, then cut in to the terrace talk. motion, av — edt_reestablisher Reestablisher — Reestablish the room after coverage so geography is honest again. motion, av — edt_bridge_shot Bridge Shot — Insert a bridge shot of the hallway so two rooms can join without a jump. motion, av — edt_buffer_shot Buffer Shot — Drop a buffer shot of sky between two harsh angles so the join can breathe. motion, av — edt_overlap_action Overlapped Action — Overlap action across the cut, repeating a few frames of the sit so the body feels continuous. motion, av — edt_ellipsis Ellipsis Cut — Ellipsis-cut the wait, skipping the dull middle so packing becomes arrival. motion, av — edt_rhythmic_montage Rhythmic Montage — Cut a rhythmic montage of footsteps, doors, and clocks on even lengths. motion, av — edt_tonal_montage Tonal Montage — Build a tonal montage of rain, unmade beds, and cold coffee, mood not plot. motion, av — edt_metric_montage Metric Montage — Cut a metric montage on strict frame-counts, picture changing like a metronome. motion, av — edt_intellectual_montage Intellectual Montage — Join an intellectual montage: the handshake then the unmarked contract then the emptied glass. motion, av — edt_cross_dissolve_time Dissolve Across Hours — Cross-dissolve across hours so the same chair occupies noon and evening in one melt. motion, av — edt_fade_white_exit Fade To White Exit — Fade to white as an exit from the fever, then fade in on clean morning air. motion, av — edt_dip_color Dip Through Color — Dip through a solid color—deep teal—between scenes instead of black. motion, av — edt_superimpose Superimpose — Superimpose the letter over the reader so words and eyes share the plate. motion, av — edt_split_screen_edit Split Screen Edit — Split-screen the two callers so both rooms play at once along a center seam. motion, av — edt_barn_wipe Barn Door Wipe — Barn-door wipe from the center, two panels opening onto the next place. motion, av — edt_star_wipe Star Wipe — Star-wipe the variety beat, a pointed iris of the new scene punching through. motion, av — edt_push_wipe Push Wipe — Push-wipe the new scene in from the side, the old plate sliding off as if on a track. motion, av — edt_spin_wipe Spin Wipe — Spin-wipe the join, the plate rotating into the next cartoon beat. motion, av — edt_match_shape_circle Circle Shape Match — Match a circle—the mouth of a cup—to a circular tunnel, shape carrying the cut. motion, av — edt_match_motion_vector Motion Vector Match — Match motion vectors so a leftward pan hands to a leftward walk without a bump. motion, av — edt_audio_bridge Audio Bridge — Bridge with continuous world sound under a picture cut, the rain never breaking. motion, av — edt_sound_advance Sound Advance — Advance the next scene's world SFX by a second so ears arrive before eyes. motion, av — edt_sound_lag Sound Lag — Lag the old scene's world SFX under the new picture for a breath, then let it die. motion, av — edt_smash_to_silence Smash To Silence — Smash-cut to silence, picture continuing in a mute room after the roar. motion, av — edt_smash_to_noise Smash To Noise — Smash-cut to noise, a quiet face exploding into crowd walla. motion, av — edt_cut_on_thunder Cut On Thunder — Cut on thunder, the clap of sky hiding the jump to the next night. motion, av — edt_cut_on_train Cut On Train — Cut on the train passing, the roar wiping picture to the station platform. motion, av — edt_cut_on_phone Cut On Phone — Cut on the phone ring, the sound starting in one room and the picture joining the other. motion, av — edt_cut_on_siren Cut On Siren — Cut on a siren rising, the wail carrying us from the kitchen to the street. motion, av — edt_montage_work Work Montage — Montage the work: measure, cut, sand, stain—four beats of the table being born. motion, av — edt_montage_travel Travel Montage — Montage travel in stamps of landscape, each cut a new unmarked horizon. motion, av — edt_montage_training Training Montage — Montage training: miss, miss, hit, then the empty gym at night. motion, av — edt_parallel_phone Parallel Phone — Parallel-cut both ends of the call, never showing them in the same room. motion, av — edt_parallel_chase Parallel Chase — Parallel-cut hunter and hunted on two streets, lengths shortening as they near. motion, av — edt_look_then_object Look Then Object — Cut from the look then to the object, eyeline first, prize second. motion, av — edt_object_then_look Object Then Look — Cut to the object first, then to the look that found it, curiosity after evidence. motion, av — edt_insert_hands Hands Insert — Insert the hands working the unmarked lock, then cut back to the listening face. motion, av — edt_insert_paper Paper Insert — Insert unmarked paper on the desk, type readable, then return to the reader. motion, av — edt_cutaway_sky Sky Cutaway — Cutaway to sky and weather, then back, a breath of scale in the talk. motion, av — edt_cutaway_clock Clock Cutaway — Cutaway to the clock, then back, time declared without a caption. motion, av — edt_time_cut_clock Time Cut On Clock — Time-cut on the clock's jump, the hands leaping, the room's light already later. motion, av — edt_season_cut Season Cut — Cut from summer leaves to the same tree in snow, a year in one join. motion, av — edt_match_costume_color Costume Color Match — Match costume color across a cut, the ochre scarf becoming an ochre wall. motion, av — edt_match_prop Prop Match Cut — Match-cut the prop: the teacup here becomes the teacup in the other house. motion, av — edt_invisible_blink Invisible Cut On Blink — Hide an invisible cut on a long blink, lids as the occluder. motion, av — edt_invisible_whip Invisible Whip Join — Hide an invisible cut in a whip smear, two rooms sharing one blur. motion, av — edt_invisible_dark Invisible Cut On Dark — Hide an invisible cut in a pass through dark, a sleeve or wall as black. motion, av — edt_axial_cut_out Axial Cut Out — Axial-cut out along the same axis, the close job becoming a wide of the shop. motion, av — edt_jump_continuity_break Continuity Jump Break — Break continuity with a jump so the glass is suddenly empty, time cheated. motion, av — edt_screen_direction_keep Keep Screen Direction — Keep screen direction so exits right are entries left, geography readable. motion, av — edt_screen_direction_flip Flip Screen Direction — Flip screen direction on the cut so the walker now goes the other way, disoriented on purpose. motion, av — edt_cut_on_light_change Cut On Light Change — Cut on a light change, the practical flaring as the angle jumps. motion, av — edt_cut_on_mirror Cut On Mirror — Cut on the mirror pass, reflection becoming the true room on the far side. motion, av — edt_match_window Window Match Cut — Match-cut window to window, rain continuing across two interiors. motion, av — edt_dissolve_to_memory Dissolve To Memory — Cross-dissolve to memory, the present kitchen melting into a smaller older one. motion, av — edt_ripple_to_dream Ripple To Dream — Ripple to dream, water over the face becoming the underwater room. motion, av — edt_focus_through_time Defocus Through Time — Defocus through time, cream blur standing in for hours, then sharpen on the later face. motion, av — edt_hard_cut_dialogue Hard Cut Dialogue — Hard cut on the last word so the answer lives in a new room. motion, av — edt_l_cut_dialogue L Cut Dialogue — L-cut the dialogue so audio continues over the listener's face after the speaker leaves frame. motion, av — edt_j_cut_dialogue J Cut Dialogue — J-cut the dialogue so we hear the next speaker before we see their room. motion, av — edt_montage_meals Meals Montage — Montage meals at the same table, plates changing, the sitter aging only in posture. motion, av — edt_cut_on_hug Cut On Hug — Cut on the hug so the arms closing hide the join to a later season. motion, av — edt_cut_on_handshake Cut On Handshake — Cut on the handshake, grip landing as the office becomes the street. motion, av — edt_insert_eyes Eyes Insert — Insert the eyes in extreme close, then cut to what they have decided. motion, av — edt_cutaway_hands_other Other Hands Cutaway — Cutaway to other hands in another room, then back, parallel labor implied. motion, av — edt_wipe_by_vehicle Vehicle Wipe By — Wipe by a passing vehicle so the far side of the bodywork becomes a new street. motion, av — edt_pass_through_dark Pass Through Dark Join — Join two scenes by passing through dark—a tunnel, a sleeve—picture born again on the far side. motion, av — edt_match_on_spin Match On Spin — Match on spin so a turning coat becomes a turning record, rotation carrying the join. motion, av — edt_audio_cuts_musicless World Cut No Score — Cut with world SFX only, audio cuts with picture, no score under the join. motion, av — edt_hard_cut_to_black Hard Cut To Black — Hard cut to black on the last syllable, no fade, the sentence still ringing. motion, av — edt_hard_cut_from_black Hard Cut From Black — Hard cut from black into the first image, no fade-in, the street already loud. motion, av — edt_cross_cut_clocks Cross Cut Clocks — Cross-cut two clocks in two rooms, then the people they govern. motion, av — edt_jump_wardrobe Wardrobe Jump Cut — Jump-cut wardrobe in the same doorway so outfits change as if hours were discarded. motion, av — edt_axial_triple Triple Axial Punch — Punch axially three times—wide, medium, close—on the same axis as the news lands. motion, av — edt_match_silhouette Silhouette Match — Match two silhouettes, the rooftop figure becoming the statue in the park. motion, av — edt_dissolve_seasons_tree Tree Season Dissolve — Cross-dissolve the same tree through seasons, blossom melting into fruit into bare limb. motion, av — edt_l_cut_city City L Cut — Hold the terrace picture while audio continues as city walla from the next street. motion, av — edt_j_cut_ocean Ocean J Cut — Lead with ocean wash under the last interior, then cut picture to the beach. motion, av — edt_cut_on_glass_setdown Cut On Glass Setdown — Cut on the glass set down, the click hiding the jump to morning. motion, av — edt_invisible_hug_occlude Hug As Occluder — Hide an invisible cut when a hug fills the plate, the release in another season. motion, av — edt_montage_three_doors Three Doors Montage — Montage three doors opening—home, office, night—as three beats of a life. motion, av — edt_shot_reverse_insert Shot Reverse With Insert — Play shot/reverse then drop an insert of the unmarked ring before the next line. motion, av — edt_eyeline_miss Eyeline Miss — Cut an eyeline miss on purpose, they look off and we do not see what they see. motion, av — edt_parallel_weather Parallel Weather — Parallel-cut two weathers—rain here, sun there—then join the travelers in a third place. motion, av — edt_whip_through_neon Whip Through Neon — Whip-through neon, the smear of signs becoming another block. motion, av — edt_bloom_through_headlight Bloom Through Headlight — Bloom through a headlight into the next night drive, white then road. motion, av — edt_defocus_through_tears Defocus Through Tears — Defocus-through tears, the first face going to water then the later face sharpening. motion, av — edt_clock_wipe_hours Clock Wipe Hours — Clock-wipe to declare hours passed, the hand sweeping noon into evening in the same kitchen. motion, av — edt_linear_wipe_map Linear Wipe Map — Linear-wipe as if a map edge traveling, one city giving way to the next along a meridian. motion, av — edt_iris_in_on_arrival Iris In On Arrival — Iris in on the arrival, a circle opening from the suitcase to the whole lobby. motion, av — edt_hard_cut_weather Hard Cut Weather — Hard cut from dry talk to a soaked street, weather as the only join. motion, av — edt_match_cut_eyes Match Cut Eyes — Make a match cut from a closing eye to a camera shutter, seeing as mechanism. motion, av — edt_audio_continues_footsteps Footsteps Continue — Hold the outgoing stair picture while audio continues as footsteps into the next hall. motion, av — edt_audio_cuts_door Door Audio Cuts — Cut so audio cuts with the door, the hall dying the instant the latch hits. motion, av —

docs.title: Framing and Shot Size
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • 131 spliceable techniques for Framing and Shot Size
  • Still mode clause; I2V include False
  • 0 muted 5s illustration clips shipped
  • Ids for the Cinema Rack combo (pick one per axis)

What this enables

  • Picking a professional cinematography clause instead of guessing camera language
  • Opening a technique page to watch a 5s example when the clip is shipped
  • Seeing conflicts, still/motion/AV flags, and the Wan token when present

Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_cinema_docs.py. Operator playbook: Cinema Rack.

Id Label Example Clause Use on Conflicts size_ecu Extreme Close-Up — Fill the rectangle with a fragment of face so pores, a catchlight, and one eyebrow become the entire landscape. still, motion, av — size_ecu_iris Iris Insert — Crop until a single iris, pupil, and catchlight occupy the whole pane, lashes grazing the edges. still, motion, av — size_ecu_tear Tear Insert — Isolate a tear on a cheek so the droplet and skin grain replace any sense of a full face. still, motion, av — size_ecu_mouth Mouth Insert — Fill the pane with lips and teeth so speech becomes a moving landscape of moisture and enamel. still, motion, av — size_ecu_breath Breath Insert — Crop to nostrils and upper lip so exhaled vapor or a tremor is the only action. still, motion, av — size_choker Choker — Crop just under the chin and through the hairline so the neck almost vanishes and the face feels too close. still, motion, av — size_ecu_ear Ear Insert — Let an ear, earring, and a strip of jaw own the rectangle, the rest of the head implied offscreen. still, motion, av — size_ecu_hands Hands Insert — Fill with fingers working an object so knuckles, tendons, and the tool become the scene. still, motion, av — size_ecu_handshake Handshake Insert — Crop two meeting palms so the grip and ring fingers tell the deal. still, motion, av — size_ecu_palm Palm Insert — Open a single palm toward the lens until creases and a held token fill the pane. still, motion, av — size_ecu_fingertips Fingertip Insert — Magnify fingertips on a surface so prints, grit, and contact are the story. still, motion, av — size_ecu_feet Feet Insert — Crop to shoes and pavement so gait, scuff, and the next step own the picture. still, motion, av — size_ecu_toes Toes Insert — Isolate bare toes on tile so nails and grout lines replace the body. still, motion, av — size_ecu_ankles Ankle Insert — Hold ankles and hems so standing weight and a puddle tell the wait. still, motion, av — size_insert_ring Ring Insert — Magnify a ring on a finger against cloth so metal and fabric are the only readable objects. still, motion, av — size_insert_key Key Insert — Crop a key entering a lock so bitting and the keyhole eclipse the hand. still, motion, av — size_insert_drink Drink Insert — Fill with a glass rim, liquid, and condensation so the pour is the event. still, motion, av — size_insert_document Document Insert — Hold unmarked paper so blocks of type, a stamp, and a signature fill the pane. still, motion, av — size_insert_product Product Insert — Pack a product so its silhouette and a specular edge sit in a clean field. still, motion, av — size_insert_label Label Insert — Crop an unmarked bottle label so paper fiber, glue line, and letterforms are readable. still, motion, av — size_insert_screen Screen Insert — Fill with a glowing unmarked display so interface glow, not the room, owns exposure. still, motion, av — size_insert_phone Handheld Screen — Crop a handheld screen in palms so the glow lights fingers and the room falls away. still, motion, av — size_insert_clock Clock Cutaway — Cut away to a clock face so hands and numerals announce time without the people. still, motion, av — size_insert_food Food Insert — Magnify a bite on a plate so steam, sauce, and garnish become terrain. still, motion, av — size_bcu Big Close-Up — Crop brow to mouth so eyes and nostrils dominate, forehead and chin clipped. still, motion, av — size_cu Close-Up — Hold a face from mid-forehead to just below the chin with shoulders only hinted. still, motion, av — size_mcu Medium Close-Up — Cut at mid-chest so face, neck, and a collar sit with breathing room above the hair. still, motion, av — size_head_shoulders Head and Shoulders — Include both shoulders and the full head so posture reads before expression. still, motion, av — size_ms Medium Shot — Cut at the waist so hands can enter, belt visible, environment a muted band behind. still, motion, av — size_cowboy Cowboy — Cut mid-thigh so a belt line, holster height, and torso read as a standing figure of action. still, motion, av — size_leaner Leaner — Let a figure lean into the pane from the edge so torso and face arrive while hips stay offscreen. still, motion, av — size_mls Medium Long Shot — Cut at the shins so knees, stride, and most of the body read against a readable room. still, motion, av — size_knee Knee Shot — Cut at the knees so gesture from thigh up is complete and the floor is only a strip. still, motion, av — size_full Full Shot — Include head to toe with a ribbon of floor and a ribbon of air so the whole costume reads. still, motion, av — size_full_grounded Grounded Full — Plant the feet on the bottom edge with almost no floor, head clearing the top by a breath. still, motion, av — size_long Long Shot — Place a full body small enough that architecture and path around them are equally important. still, motion, av — size_very_long Very Long Shot — Shrink the figure until clothing color becomes a speck and the street or field is the true owner. still, motion, av — size_ews Extreme Wide Shot — Hold a landscape or city massing where a person is optional and weather owns the scale. still, motion, av — size_els Extreme Long Shot — Set a traveler tiny on a road or ridge so distance, not expression, is the information. still, motion, av — size_ws_interior Interior Wide — Take in ceiling, floor, and opposing walls so the room becomes a complete box around anyone inside. still, motion, av — size_master_int Interior Master — Cover the whole playing area of a room so every doorway, seat, and crossing is visible at once. still, motion, av — size_master_ext Exterior Master — Hold the building, sidewalk, and approach so geography of the scene is complete before closer coverage. still, motion, av — size_establishing Establishing — Open on the unmarked place from outside so the audience can name the location before any face. still, motion, av — size_establishing_weather Weather Establishing — Show the place under current sky so rain, haze, or glare is the first fact. still, motion, av — size_establishing_aerial Aerial Establishing — Survey from altitude so roof, courtyard, and surrounding streets map the site. still, motion, av — size_reestablishing Re-establishing — Return to a broader view after close coverage so the room's new blocking and emptied chairs are clear. still, motion, av — size_reestablishing_reverse Reverse Re-establish — Re-open the scene from the opposite side so previously unseen walls and exits appear. still, motion, av — size_cutaway_window Window Cutaway — Cut away to a window view so outside traffic or weather comments without the speakers. still, motion, av — size_cutaway_crowd Crowd Cutaway — Cut away to watching faces so reaction, not the action, fills the pane. still, motion, av — size_cutaway_sky Sky Cutaway — Cut away to unmarked sky and a roofline so time of day continues without bodies. still, motion, av — size_cutaway_other_hands Other Hands Cutaway — Cut away to someone else's hands elsewhere in the room doing a private task. still, motion, av — size_insert_prop Prop Detail Insert — Magnify a story object on a table so scratches and use-wear replace the owners. still, motion, av — size_two_shot Two-Shot — Fit two people in one rectangle so both faces and the air between them are readable. still, motion, av — size_two_shot_walk Walking Two-Shot — Hold two walkers side by side so paired stride and shared path fill the width. still, motion, av — size_two_shot_seated Seated Two-Shot — Sit two people at a table so plates, hands, and both torsos share the pane. still, motion, av — size_two_shot_profile Profile Two-Shot — Face two profiles toward each other so noses and the gap between them are the axis. still, motion, av — size_fifty_fifty Fifty-Fifty — Split the rectangle evenly between two facing bodies so neither owns more area than the other. still, motion, av — size_power_two Power Two-Shot — Stand one figure over a seated other so stature, not dialogue, states the rank. still, motion, av — size_stacked_two Stacked Two-Shot — Align one head in front of another so the rear person becomes a stacked halo behind the nearer face. still, motion, av — size_three_shot Three-Shot — Arrange three people so all faces read, typically a triangle of seats or shoulders. still, motion, av — size_three_shot_line Line Three-Shot — Line three bodies across the pane so a bench or railing holds them in a row. still, motion, av — size_group Group Shot — Fit a cluster of four or more so relationships of height and huddle are visible. still, motion, av — size_group_table Table Group — Surround a table with a dining or meeting cluster so faces, plates, and the tabletop oval all read. still, motion, av — size_crowd_wide Crowd Wide — Fill the place with a crowd so individuals melt into density and the mass is the owner. still, motion, av — size_crowd_packed Packed Crowd — Compress bodies until shoulders and heads tile the rectangle with almost no ground. still, motion, av — size_crowd_behind Behind the Crowd — Shoot from among backs of heads so the distant event is glimpsed through a forest of hair. still, motion, av — size_figure_in_crowd Isolated in Crowd — Keep one sharp figure in a sea of softer bodies so isolation reads inside density. still, motion, av — size_clean_single Clean Single — Isolate one person with empty air around them, no other body even as a blur. still, motion, av — size_dirty_single Dirty Single — Keep one person as the focus while a smear of another body or object dirties an edge. still, motion, av — size_profile_single Profile Single — Turn one person to full profile so the nose-to-nape silhouette is the owner. still, motion, av — size_profile_walker Profile Walker — Hold a walking profile so the stride becomes a side-view cutout against the wall. still, motion, av — size_ots_dirty_l Dirty OTS Left — Blur a foreground cheek and ear so the speaker beyond is seen past living flesh. still, motion, av — size_ots_dirty_r Dirty OTS Right — Park a foreground jaw, collar, and shoulder mass as a dark slab the distant face must clear. still, motion, av — size_ots_clean_l Clean OTS Left — Aim past an empty shoulder line with no flesh in the foreground plane, the distant person clean and full. still, motion, av — size_ots_clean_r Clean OTS Right — Use architecture as the shoulder stand-in so the distant face is clean, no cheek in the pane. still, motion, av — size_ots_deep Deep Over-Shoulder — Keep the foreground body large and the distant person small in a doorway so depth, not equality, rules. still, motion, av — size_ots_reverse Reverse Over-Shoulder — Flip to the opposite over-shoulder so the previous listener's face now owns the distant plane. still, motion, av — size_single_front Front Single — Face one person square to the lens so both ears are hinted and the gaze hits the glass. still, motion, av — size_single_three_q Three-Quarter Single — Turn the body forty-five degrees so one ear hides and the closer shoulder leads. still, motion, av — size_open_frame Open Frame — Leave an exit of empty air on the travel side so the person could walk out without hitting a wall of the pane. still, motion, av — size_closed_frame Closed Frame — Box the person with door jambs, shelves, or a window grid so the world feels sealed around them. still, motion, av — size_looking_room Looking Room — Put extra air in front of the eyes so the gaze has a place to land inside the rectangle. still, motion, av — size_lead_room Lead Room — Put extra air in front of a moving body so the path they are about to take is visible. still, motion, av — size_short_sided Short-Sided — Crowd the face toward the edge they stare at so the back of the head sits in empty air and the gaze feels trapped. still, motion, av — size_nose_room Nose Room — Give a profile extra air beyond the nose so the face is not kissing the edge. still, motion, av — size_foot_room Foot Room — Include a strip of floor beyond the toes so stance and the next step have ground. still, motion, av — size_crushed_headroom Crushed Headroom — Let the crown graze or break the top edge so the ceiling feels too close. still, motion, av — size_generous_headroom Generous Headroom — Stack extra air above the hair so the person sits sunk and the architecture towers. still, motion, av — size_doorway_frame Doorway Frame — Nest the person in a doorway so the jambs crop them as a picture inside the picture. still, motion, av — size_arch_frame Arch Frame — Nest the figure under an arch so stone or plaster curves become a second rectangle. still, motion, av — size_mirror_frame Mirror Frame — Hold the person only as a reflection so the real body is offscreen and glass is the set. still, motion, av — size_169_presenter 16:9 Presenter Headroom — Sit a talking head in sixteen-by-nine with a band of empty wall above the hair and a desk line holding the lower third. still, motion, av — size_169_landscape 16:9 Landscape — Spread a place across sixteen-by-nine so the horizon sits on a third and unmarked sky becomes a lid. still, motion, av — size_169_two 16:9 Conversation — Fit a seated pair in sixteen-by-nine so both faces live in the middle band with lamps in the side panels. still, motion, av — docs.title: In-Camera and Optical Effects
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • 142 spliceable techniques for In-Camera and Optical Effects
  • Still mode freeze; I2V include True
  • 0 muted 5s illustration clips shipped
  • Ids for the Cinema Rack combo (pick one per axis)

What this enables

  • Picking a professional cinematography clause instead of guessing camera language
  • Opening a technique page to watch a 5s example when the clip is shipped
  • Seeing conflicts, still/motion/AV flags, and the Wan token when present

Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_cinema_docs.py. Operator playbook: Cinema Rack.

the image with veiling flare so contrast collapses into a milky wash from the practical. still, motion, av — fx_ghost_orb Ghost Orb Flare — Raise a ghost orb opposite the lamp, a pale disc repeating the source across the plate. still, motion, av — fx_rain_on_lens Rain On Lens — Leave rain beads on the front element so city lamps smear through each drop. still, motion, av — fx_smear_across_glass docs.title: Lenses and Optics
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • 141 spliceable techniques for Lenses and Optics
  • Still mode clause; I2V include False
  • 0 muted 5s illustration clips shipped
  • Ids for the Cinema Rack combo (pick one per axis)

What this enables

  • Picking a professional cinematography clause instead of guessing camera language
  • Opening a technique page to watch a 5s example when the clip is shipped
  • Seeing conflicts, still/motion/AV flags, and the Wan token when present

Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_cinema_docs.py. Operator playbook: Cinema Rack.

docs.text:
What's on this page

  • 178 spliceable techniques for Viral Looks
  • Still mode freeze; I2V include False
  • 0 muted 5s illustration clips shipped
  • Ids for the Cinema Rack combo (pick one per axis)

What this enables

  • Picking a professional cinematography clause instead of guessing camera language
  • Opening a technique page to watch a 5s example when the clip is shipped
  • Seeing conflicts, still/motion/AV flags, and the Wan token when present

Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_cinema_docs.py. Operator playbook: Cinema Rack.

docs.title: manage
docs.text:
Operator CLI for the ez-comfy-stack unified Visual Generative AI demo (ComfyUI US-safe local studio on a single NVIDIA DGX Spark).

Purpose: Single entrypoint for day-to-day stack lifecycle: preflight (doctor), status, start/stop/restart, logs, model downloads (bandwidth-limited by default), and cleanup of the Comfy state volume. Keeps heavy GPU work explicit and safe for remote-SSH operation.

Usage:
  ./scripts/manage.sh help|setup|doctor|status|start|stop|restart|logs|download-models [--limit auto|N|off] [--drop-incomplete]|download-podcast [--tier analog|acestep|chatterbox|qwen3tts|all] [--limit auto|N|off]|download-dub [--tier asr|clone|all] [--limit auto|N|off]|download-music [--tier turbo|xl|all] [--limit auto|N|off]|download-llm [--tier enhance|qwen36-35b-a3b|all] [--limit auto|N|off]|cleanup
  ./scripts/manage.sh reset-hf-partials [--yes] [--force]
  ./scripts/manage.sh download-limit status|run|clear|wrap ...

Warning

Safety: - Manual start only (compose restart: "no") - Heavy confirmation for start/restart - Host free-memory/disk headroom checks before start - Model downloads default to bandwidth-limited (download-limit auto @ 85%) - Always stop before node reboot - setup may use sudo only to create/chown MODELS_DIR# Environment: See .env.example — MODELS_DIR, HF_TOKEN, MEM_LIMIT, DOWNLOAD_LIMIT, LAB_NON_INTERACTIVE, LAB_CONFIRM_TOKEN, MIN_HOST_FREE_GIB, etc.

docs.title: common

Purpose: Keep operator diagnostics consistent (prefixed; always on stderr) so stdout remains free for machine-readable data such as --json payloads.

docs.title: compose
docs.text:
Docker Compose wrappers for the unified ComfyUI US-safe studio stack.

Purpose: Isolate every docker/compose invocation behind helpers that pin the project file (docker/docker-compose.yml) and project name (ez-comfy). This keeps manage.sh thin and makes hermetic tests able to inject COMPOSE_BIN mocks.

Audience: Sourced by manage.sh after paths.sh and common.sh.

Environment: MODELS_DIR, COMFY_PORT, MEM_LIMIT, MEM_RESERVATION — exported into compose COMPOSE_BIN — optional full command override for tests (space-separated ok) LAB_STACK_FOLLOW — 1 = stream logs until UI port is open (default 0: detach)

Warning

Safety: stack_start does not ask for confirmation (caller must require_heavy_confirm). stack_start ignores SIGHUP so an SSH drop does not abort compose up. stack_start returns after up -d + verify; it does not stay bound to the shell. stack_cleanup_state removes named volumes but never deletes host MODELS_DIR. restart: "no" is unchanged — logout is not a reboot and does not auto-start.

docs.title: safety
docs.text:
Preflight checks, heavy confirmation, and host headroom for remote Spark safety.

Purpose: DGX Spark hosts are often operated over the internet without physical access. Starting a 90 GiB-class ComfyUI stack without free RAM/disk headroom can make SSH unresponsive. This library enforces explicit operator consent and minimum free resources before heavy work begins.

Invariants:

  • Heavy workloads never auto-start (Compose restart policy is "no"; this lib only gates explicit start paths).

  • Interactive start requires typing "yes" (case-insensitive full word).

  • Non-interactive automation requires LAB_NON_INTERACTIVE=1 and a matching LAB_CONFIRM_TOKEN (yes for start, DELETE for cleanup).

Audience: Sourced by manage.sh (and tests). Depends on common.sh (log/warn/err) and paths.sh (lab_models_dir) being available in the caller.

Environment (defaults applied if unset): MIN_HOST_FREE_GIB — minimum free host RAM in GiB (default 28) MIN_DISK_FREE_GIB — minimum free disk on models path in GiB (default 40) MEM_LIMIT — Docker mem_limit string, e.g. 90g (default 90g) LAB_MOCK_FREE_MEM_GIB / LAB_MOCK_DISK_FREE_GIB — hermetic test overrides LAB_NON_INTERACTIVE / LAB_CONFIRM_TOKEN — automation confirm path

docs.title: download-limit
docs.text:
Limit host download bandwidth so multi‑GB model pulls cannot starve remote SSH.

Purpose: Apply kernel traffic shaping via wondershaper on the default-route interface. Supports fixed Mbps caps and an auto mode that measures download Mbps (duration HTTP probe first, then Ookla, then speedtest-cli) and applies floor(0.85 × measured_download_mbps). Auto measurements are cached 24h on the host (not MODELS_DIR). Apply is verified via tc qdisc (or mocks). The wrap subcommand always clears limits on EXIT/INT/TERM so a killed download cannot leave the host permanently throttled. If apply fails, wrap soft-fails (warn + continue unthrottled) unless DOWNLOAD_LIMIT_REQUIRE=1.

Audience: Operators on remotely managed DGX Spark nodes; also invoked by manage.sh download-models.

Usage:

download-limit.sh status [--json] [--refresh] download-limit.sh run --limit auto|N [--fallback N] [--refresh] download-limit.sh clear download-limit.sh wrap --limit auto|N [--refresh] --

Requirements:

  • sudo (unless LAB_NO_SUDO=1 for mocks)

  • wondershaper (best-effort auto-install on apt/dnf/pacman)

  • HTB/sch_* kernel modules for real shaping

  • speedtest-cli or Ookla speedtest for auto mode (optional with fallback)

Test hooks: LAB_MOCK_IFACE, LAB_MOCK_WONDERSHAPER, LAB_MOCK_SPEEDTEST_MBPS, LAB_MOCK_HTTP_SPEED_MBPS, LAB_MOCK_LIMITS_ACTIVE, LAB_NO_SUDO, DOWNLOAD_LIMIT_REQUIRE, DOWNLOAD_LIMIT_CACHE_DIR, DOWNLOAD_LIMIT_CACHE_TTL_SEC

Units: Limits are megabits per second (Mbps), not MB/s. 40 Mbps ≈ 5 MB/s. Wondershaper rates are clamped to a legal HTB kbps range.

Exit codes: 0 success (or wrap soft-fail with command success); 1 invalid args, missing interface, or hard apply failure (run / REQUIRE wrap).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy audio. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## audio/stem-mix

Picture-lock stem mix. Occupancy **audio** — stop Klein / Wan / LTX first. ACE-Step
score is a later session if `score: acestep-instrumental`.

This canvas does not denoise video. Mix on the host:

  ./scripts/manage.sh stem-mix --film <slug> --shot <id> --bg PATH [--dx PATH]

Stems: BG = demuxed LTX world bed, FX = optional Templates LTX-2.5 T2A (same distilled
transformer; not a vendored subgraph), DX = Kokoro / Qwen3-TTS, MX = ACE-Step
instrumental. Duck beds −15 dB under DX. YouTube loudnorm I=-14.

A2V lock (talking-head): mix DX first, then Templates → LTX-2.5 A2V freeze. Mouths will
not match (banned lip-sync OSS stays out). Foley V2A LoRA is not in v1.

Do not start Docker. Do not co-resident ACE-Step with LTX.

Occupancy: audio — stop Klein / Wan / LTX session. One GB10 job.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Numbered takes under audio/albums/drive-through/afterparty/. Queue one track, or ./scripts/manage.sh album-render --album drive-through/afterparty.

## 01-brake-fade

US-safe EDM **180 s** take: **brake fade**. Fictional act **Drive-through** (hardcore, pure of heart). Native ACE-Step 1.5 turbo AIO. Live bass-set take. Instrumental score is empty-body ACE markers (`[drop - cues]`, `[inst - cues]`, `[outro]`) so ACE does not sing production notes. Drop-first warped hybrid-trap, trap drums, no quiet dips. Vocals are a rare DJ treat on other graphs, not here. Queue this graph **on its own** — draft-first is the generic rap lane, not a prerequisite. Occupancy **audio** only; a longer Queue is expected.

1. Weights: `./scripts/manage.sh download-music --tier turbo` (same AIO dest as `download-podcast --tier acestep`; ~10 GB, opt-in, not `download-models`).
2. Prompt enhance is **off** so tags, BPM, language, and `[drop]` / `[inst]` / `[outro]` stay as written. Turn Enhance on only if you want the 4B rewriter.
3. Tags vs score: tags are genre/instrument hints; lyrics are the arrangement. Keep App **Vocal / instrumental** on instrumental so ACE does not sing. Encoder language is `unknown`. Free-text lines under a marker are lyrics — keep cues inside the brackets.
4. Original arrangements only. No “in the style of <living artist>”. No living-DJ names. No famous-hook paraphrases.
5. ACE-Step timbre is **invented**, not a cloned act.
6. Sampler: 8 steps, cfg 1, euler, simple. Duration 180 s, bpm 150, language unknown, timesignature 4, generate_audio_codes true. Seed 457.
7. Saves: `01 - Brake Fade` FLAC master + 320 kbps MP3 under `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
8. Cover separately: Queue **klein/thumbnail.json** or **klein/podcast-cover.json**. Do not embed Klein here.
9. Human selection and edit before any release. Prompts are not authorship (USCO Part 2 / Thaler).
10. Do not co-resident with LTX / Wan / Klein on this Spark.

Occupancy: audio — stop Klein / Wan / LTX session. One GB10 job.

docs.title: control_after_generate

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph (all 21 instances): euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Every track, cover, and album-pack graph in this folder
  • Shared ACE-Step topology (one printer, unique widgets per take)
  • Node parameter reference for the types on these graphs

What this enables

  • Queuing one numbered take or album-render
  • Reading tags, lyrics, seed, BPM without opening raw JSON

Who this is for: studio users after download-music. Occupancy audio (cover stills are klein — separate session).

Generated from workflows/_lab/audio/albums/drive-through/headliner/. Do not hand-edit this file.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Numbered takes under audio/albums/drive-through/headliner/. Queue one track, or ./scripts/manage.sh album-render --album drive-through/headliner.

## 01-lantern-merge

US-safe EDM **180 s** take: **lantern merge**. Fictional act **Drive-through** (hardcore, pure of heart). Native ACE-Step 1.5 turbo AIO. Live bass-set take. Instrumental score is empty-body ACE markers (`[drop - cues]`, `[inst - cues]`, `[outro]`) so ACE does not sing production notes. Drop-first warped hybrid-trap, trap drums, no quiet dips. Vocals are a rare DJ treat on other graphs, not here. Queue this graph **on its own** — draft-first is the generic rap lane, not a prerequisite. Occupancy **audio** only; a longer Queue is expected.

1. Weights: `./scripts/manage.sh download-music --tier turbo` (same AIO dest as `download-podcast --tier acestep`; ~10 GB, opt-in, not `download-models`).
2. Prompt enhance is **off** so tags, BPM, language, and `[drop]` / `[inst]` / `[outro]` stay as written. Turn Enhance on only if you want the 4B rewriter.
3. Tags vs score: tags are genre/instrument hints; lyrics are the arrangement. Keep App **Vocal / instrumental** on instrumental so ACE does not sing. Encoder language is `unknown`. Free-text lines under a marker are lyrics — keep cues inside the brackets.
4. Original arrangements only. No “in the style of <living artist>”. No living-DJ names. No famous-hook paraphrases.
5. ACE-Step timbre is **invented**, not a cloned act.
6. Sampler: 8 steps, cfg 1, euler, simple. Duration 180 s, bpm 150, language unknown, timesignature 4, generate_audio_codes true. Seed 367.
7. Saves: `01 - Lantern Merge` FLAC master + 320 kbps MP3 under `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
8. Cover separately: Queue **klein/thumbnail.json** or **klein/podcast-cover.json**. Do not embed Klein here.
9. Human selection and edit before any release. Prompts are not authorship (USCO Part 2 / Thaler).
10. Do not co-resident with LTX / Wan / Klein on this Spark.

Occupancy: audio — stop Klein / Wan / LTX session. One GB10 job.

docs.title: Node parameter reference
docs.text: Every unique node type on this graph. Widgets are in lab JSON order. Choices are ComfyUI v0.34.6 / lab INPUT_TYPES — not SD1.5 folklore.

docs.title: CheckpointLoaderSimple — Load Checkpoint
docs.text:
Load a single-file checkpoint that bundles MODEL + CLIP + VAE.

Lab notes

ACE-Step 1.5 turbo AIO (ace_step_1.5_turbo_aio.safetensors) on every music graph.

Socket Dir Type What it carries MODEL out MODEL ACE denoiser (then ModelSamplingAuraFlow). CLIP out CLIP ACE text encoder. VAE out VAE ACE audio VAE.

docs.title: ckpt_name
docs.text:
Type STRING.

Filename under checkpoints/.

How it affects generation: Lab music is the turbo AIO. XL is opt-in via download-music --tier xl — swap only if you meant to.

This graph (all 15 instances): ace_step_1.5_turbo_aio.safetensors

docs.title: ModelSamplingAuraFlow — ModelSamplingAuraFlow
docs.text:
Patch ACE-Step with AuraFlow sampling shift.

Lab notes

Every ACE graph uses shift 3.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL ACE checkpoint MODEL. MODEL out MODEL Shifted ACE denoiser.

docs.title: shift
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 3 (lab ACE).

AuraFlow shift.

How it affects generation: 3 is the ACE-Step 1.5 lab value. Higher shift changes timing/attack of the beat.

This graph (all 15 instances): 3

docs.title: PrimitiveNode — Primitive
docs.text:
A typed constant (string or float) with seed-style control.

Lab notes

Music Duration (FLOAT) and Prompt Forge Context (STRING). widgets[1] is always control_after_generate.

Socket Dir Type What it carries value out FLOAT\|STRING Wired into duration / context / lyrics.

docs.title: value
docs.text:
Type FLOAT|STRING.

The constant.

How it affects generation: FLOAT seconds drive ACE latent length. STRING context is bible/research for Enhance.

This graph (all 15 instances): 180.0

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed.

Whether the primitive mutates after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps duration/context pinned.

This graph (all 15 instances): fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: EmptyAceStep1.5LatentAudio — Empty ACE-Step 1.5 Latent Audio
docs.text:
Allocate an ACE-Step audio latent for N seconds.

Lab notes

Draft 32 s, full 96 s, album takes 180 s. seconds is also a socket from PrimitiveNode so App Duration stays in one place.

Socket Dir Type What it carries seconds in FLOAT Wired from Song Duration primitive on music graphs. LATENT out LATENT Audio latent for KSampler.

docs.title: seconds
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 32 / 96 / 180 lab.

Duration in seconds.

How it affects generation: Longer latents cost RAM/time linearly. Stay at the seeded length unless you have headroom.

This graph (all 15 instances): 180.0

docs.title: batch_size
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1.

Takes per Queue.

How it affects generation: Stay 1.

This graph (all 15 instances): 1

docs.title: EZAceStepPromptEnhance — ACE-Step Prompt Enhance
docs.text:
Rewrite ACE tags (genre first) and lyrics. Instrumental mode forces [inst].

Lab notes

Enhance off on authored album takes. Instrumental sanitizes lyrics into bracket cues.

Socket Dir Type What it carries lyrics in STRING Optional lyrics override (EZRapLyrics). tags out STRING Tags for the ACE encoder. lyrics out STRING Lyrics / [inst] for the ACE encoder.

docs.title: sample
docs.text:

Sample or Custom.

How it affects generation: Custom keeps authored tags/lyrics.

docs.title: tags
docs.text:
Type STRING.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph (all 16 instances): euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Every track, cover, and album-pack graph in this folder
  • Shared ACE-Step topology (one printer, unique widgets per take)
  • Node parameter reference for the types on these graphs

What this enables

  • Queuing one numbered take or album-render
  • Reading tags, lyrics, seed, BPM without opening raw JSON

Who this is for: studio users after download-music. Occupancy audio (cover stills are klein — separate session).

Generated from workflows/_lab/audio/albums/drive-through/hour-1/. Do not hand-edit this file.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Numbered takes under audio/albums/drive-through/hour-1/. Queue one track, or ./scripts/manage.sh album-render --album drive-through/hour-1.

## 01-night-window

US-safe EDM **180 s** take: **night window**. Fictional act **Drive-through** (hardcore, pure of heart). Native ACE-Step 1.5 turbo AIO. Live bass-set take. Instrumental score is empty-body ACE markers (`[drop - cues]`, `[inst - cues]`, `[outro]`) so ACE does not sing production notes. Drop-first warped hybrid-trap, trap drums, no quiet dips. Vocals are a rare DJ treat on other graphs, not here. Queue this graph **on its own** — draft-first is the generic rap lane, not a prerequisite. Occupancy **audio** only; a longer Queue is expected.

1. Weights: `./scripts/manage.sh download-music --tier turbo` (same AIO dest as `download-podcast --tier acestep`; ~10 GB, opt-in, not `download-models`).
2. Prompt enhance is **off** so tags, BPM, language, and `[drop]` / `[inst]` / `[outro]` stay as written. Turn Enhance on only if you want the 4B rewriter.
3. Tags vs score: tags are genre/instrument hints; lyrics are the arrangement. Keep App **Vocal / instrumental** on instrumental so ACE does not sing. Encoder language is `unknown`. Free-text lines under a marker are lyrics — keep cues inside the brackets.
4. Original arrangements only. No “in the style of <living artist>”. No living-DJ names. No famous-hook paraphrases.

7. Saves: `01 - Night Window` FLAC master + 320 kbps MP3 under `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
8. Cover separately: Queue **klein/thumbnail.json** or **klein/podcast-cover.json**. Do not embed Klein here.
9. Human selection and edit before any release. Prompts are not authorship (USCO Part 2 / Thaler).
10. Do not co-resident with LTX / Wan / Klein on this Spark.

What's on this page

  • Every track, cover, and album-pack graph in this folder
  • Shared ACE-Step topology (one printer, unique widgets per take)

What this enables

  • Queuing one numbered take or album-render
  • Reading tags, lyrics, seed, BPM without opening raw JSON

Generated from workflows/_lab/audio/albums/drive-through/hour-2/. Do not hand-edit this file.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Numbered takes under audio/albums/drive-through/hour-2/. Queue one track, or ./scripts/manage.sh album-render --album drive-through/hour-2.

## 01-rumble-strip

US-safe EDM **180 s** take: **rumble strip**. Fictional act **Drive-through** (hardcore, pure of heart). Native ACE-Step 1.5 turbo AIO. Live bass-set take. Instrumental score is empty-body ACE markers (`[drop - cues]`, `[inst - cues]`, `[outro]`) so ACE does not sing production notes. Drop-first warped hybrid-trap, trap drums, no quiet dips. Vocals are a rare DJ treat on other graphs, not here. Queue this graph **on its own** — draft-first is the generic rap lane, not a prerequisite. Occupancy **audio** only; a longer Queue is expected.

1. Weights: `./scripts/manage.sh download-music --tier turbo` (same AIO dest as `download-podcast --tier acestep`; ~10 GB, opt-in, not `download-models`).
2. Prompt enhance is **off** so tags, BPM, language, and `[drop]` / `[inst]` / `[outro]` stay as written. Turn Enhance on only if you want the 4B rewriter.
3. Tags vs score: tags are genre/instrument hints; lyrics are the arrangement. Keep App **Vocal / instrumental** on instrumental so ACE does not sing. Encoder language is `unknown`. Free-text lines under a marker are lyrics — keep cues inside the brackets.
4. Original arrangements only. No “in the style of <living artist>”. No living-DJ names. No famous-hook paraphrases.
5. ACE-Step timbre is **invented**, not a cloned act.
6. Sampler: 8 steps, cfg 1, euler, simple. Duration 180 s, bpm 140, language unknown, timesignature 4, generate_audio_codes true. Seed 271.
7. Saves: `01 - Rumble Strip` FLAC master + 320 kbps MP3 under `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
8. Cover separately: Queue **klein/thumbnail.json** or **klein/podcast-cover.json**. Do not embed Klein here.
9. Human selection and edit before any release. Prompts are not authorship (USCO Part 2 / Thaler).
10. Do not co-resident with LTX / Wan / Klein on this Spark.

Occupancy: audio — stop Klein / Wan / LTX session. One GB10 job.

docs.text:
