docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 8

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: denoise
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–1; lab 1.0.

Fraction of the latent to replace with denoised signal.

How it affects generation: 1.0 is full generation (T2I / T2V / ACE). Values below 1 keep structure from an encoded start image (Klein edit / clay). Lab I2V uses dedicated latent nodes, not denoise<1 on empty noise.

This graph: 1.0

This graph: ## klein/endcard-cta Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size. YouTube/end-card still (Klein 4B). Default 1280×720. Prefixez_endcard. Keep the lower…

## klein/endcard-cta

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

YouTube/end-card still (Klein 4B). Default 1280×720. Prefix `ez_endcard`.
Keep the lower-right quiet — add CTA text in your editor, not in the prompt.

Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

How it affects generation: Custom keeps the textarea. Picking a sample fills and locks the Prompt. The App dropdown lists this graph's 20 recipes plus Custom (place recipes such as Cliff villa on klein/dream-house).

docs.title: prompt
docs.text:
Type STRING.

Lazy sentence or authored still prompt.

How it affects generation: When Enhance is on, the GGUF expands this into Klein-native sentences.

This graph: A photoreal still of a tropical coastal city rooftop terrace at golden hour. An original techno wizard in an unmarked sun-washed teal technical running coat with faint circuit-thread seams stands mid…

A photoreal still of a tropical coastal city rooftop terrace at golden hour. An original techno wizard in an unmarked sun-washed teal technical running coat with faint circuit-thread seams stands mid-stride on the terrace. Warm gold-cyan holographic glyph rings bloom from a compact unmarked data-staff, empty of lettering. Framed as a YouTube end-card plate: generous empty lower-right for a subscribe button later. Clean of burned-in text, logos, or UI chrome. Photoreal still 16:9.

docs.text:

How it affects generation: t2i = new still. edit = change an existing still. identity = camera-free bible (identity-sheet). text_swap = glyph-lock lettering on a source still.

Choice What it does t2i New still. edit Klein-edit / clay / tweak. identity Camera-free identity bible. text_swap Replace lettering; source still owns look and size.

What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded klein/food-tabletop from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/klein/food-tabletop.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/food-tabletop

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Food / tabletop still (Klein 4B). Default 1024×1280 (4:5). Prefix `ez_tabletop`.
Swap the dish in the prompt; keep unmarked surfaces.

Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/food-tabletop from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

docs.text:

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 8

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.text:

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/hook-still

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

First-frame Shorts hook still (Klein 4B). Default 432×768 (9:16). Prefix `ez_hook_still`.
Feed into **wan/shorts-still-5s** or **ltx/hook-av**.

Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/hook-still from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 4

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: denoise
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–1; lab 1.0.

Fraction of the latent to replace with denoised signal.

How it affects generation: 1.0 is full generation (T2I / T2V / ACE). Values below 1 keep structure from an encoded start image (Klein edit / clay). Lab I2V uses dedicated latent nodes, not denoise<1 on empty noise.

This graph: 1.0

## klein/hook-still

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

First-frame Shorts hook still (Klein 4B). Default 432×768 (9:16). Prefix `ez_hook_still`.
Feed into **wan/shorts-still-5s** or **ltx/hook-av**.

docs.title: klein/identity-sheet
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded klein/identity-sheet from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/klein/identity-sheet.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/identity-sheet

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Three-angle Klein identity sheet. Type any character in IDENTITY. Frozen seed 42. Identity-mode enhance is on. Optional style dropdown applies to the bible.
Prints ez_identity_front / ez_identity_threequarter / ez_identity_profile.
I2V feeders stay 1280×704. Unload before LTX prints.

Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.

Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used. Turn Enhance off to pin the widget text.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/identity-sheet from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph (all 3 instances): 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph (all 3 instances): fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph (all 3 instances): 4

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph (all 3 instances): 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph (all 3 instances): euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph (all 3 instances): simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. docs.text:

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: klein/lighting-trio
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded klein/lighting-trio from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/klein/lighting-trio.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/lighting-trio

Same subject under three lights (Klein 4B). Type any subject in IDENTITY. SHOT KEY is the identity plate. Queue the whole graph; 02–03 Klein-edit from 01 (VAEEncode + ReferenceLatent). Do not bypass KEY on a cold canvas.
Prefixes `ez_light_01`…`03` (key / window / night lamp). Change only the light.

Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used. Turn Enhance off to pin the widget text.

Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/lighting-trio from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

## klein/lighting-trio

Same subject under three lights (Klein 4B). Type any subject in IDENTITY. SHOT KEY is the identity plate. Queue the whole graph; 02–03 Klein-edit from 01 (VAEEncode + ReferenceLatent). Do not bypass KEY on a cold canvas.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph (all 3 instances): 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph (all 3 instances): fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph (all 3 instances): 4

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph (all 3 instances): 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph (all 3 instances): euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph (all 3 instances): simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/lower-third-bg

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Lower-third-safe 16:9 plate (Klein 4B). Default 1280×720. Prefix `ez_lowerthird`.
Keep the bottom band empty; composite titles later.

Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/lower-third-bg from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 8

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: klein/open-graph
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded klein/open-graph from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/klein/open-graph.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/open-graph

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Blog / Open Graph hero (Klein 4B). Default 1216×640. Prefix `ez_og`.
Leave space for a title overlay. No burned-in words.

Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/open-graph from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.text:

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 8

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: denoise
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–1; lab 1.0.

Fraction of the latent to replace with denoised signal.

How it affects generation: 1.0 is full generation (T2I / T2V / ACE). Values below 1 keep structure from an encoded start image (Klein edit / clay). Lab I2V uses dedicated latent nodes, not denoise<1 on empty noise.

docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded klein/platform-pack from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/klein/platform-pack.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/platform-pack

One identity, six platform plates (Klein 4B distilled, 4 steps, CFG 1.0, seed 42). Type any subject in PACK IDENTITY. Identity-mode enhance is **on** (camera-free bible). Each plate is independent T2I (own latent, no ReferenceLatent across aspect ratios). Hidden cards are framing only.

Prefixes and sizes (copy of the single-plate graphs):
- ez_pack_thumb 1280x720
- ez_pack_ig 1024x1024 (1:1)
- ez_pack_portrait 1024x1280 (Instagram 4:5)
- ez_pack_shorts 432x768 (9:16)
- ez_pack_og 1216x640
- ez_pack_banner 1536x512 (~3:1)

Unused SHOT groups may be bypassed (Ctrl+B). Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Handoff: Spark Still → this pack → Silent 5s / Hook AV.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/platform-pack from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

## klein/platform-pack

One identity, six platform plates (Klein 4B distilled, 4 steps, CFG 1.0, seed 42). Type any subject in PACK IDENTITY. Identity-mode enhance is **on** (camera-free bible). Each plate is independent T2I (own latent, no ReferenceLatent across aspect ratios). Hidden cards are framing only.

Prefixes and sizes (copy of the single-plate graphs):
- ez_pack_thumb 1280x720
- ez_pack_ig 1024x1024 (1:1)
- ez_pack_portrait 1024x1280 (Instagram 4:5)
- ez_pack_shorts 432x768 (9:16)
- ez_pack_og 1216x640
- ez_pack_banner 1536x512 (~3:1)

Unused SHOT groups may be bypassed (Ctrl+B). Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Handoff: Spark Still → this pack → Silent 5s / Hook AV.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph (all 6 instances): 4

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph (all 6 instances): 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph (all 6 instances): euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. docs.title: klein/product-packshot
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded klein/product-packshot from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/klein/product-packshot.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/product-packshot

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Clean product / packshot still (Klein 4B). Default 1024×1024. Prefix `ez_packshot`.
Swap the subject in the prompt; keep seamless background and soft studio light.

Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/product-packshot from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 8

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

## klein/quote-bg

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 8

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: klein/shorts-still
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded klein/shorts-still from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/klein/shorts-still.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/shorts-still

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Vertical Shorts/Reels still (Klein 4B distilled FP8). Default **432×768** (9:16).
Save prefix: `ez_shorts_still`. Feed into **wan/shorts-still-5s** or **ltx/shorts-still-5s**.
Widgets: seed / steps / CFG / size on canvas. Prompt enhance is on by default; read the rewrite on the node after Queue.

Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/shorts-still from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 4

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

What's on this page

Who this is for: studio users who loaded klein/still-daily from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/klein/still-daily.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/still-daily

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Daily Klein 4B still app. Click the UNET filename to swap Apache Klein 4B weights.
CLIP (qwen_3_4b, type flux2) and flux2-vae stay the same for every Klein 4B UNET.

Swap table:
- flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors — daily default, 4 steps, CFG 1.0
- flux-2-klein-4b-nvfp4.safetensors — Spark NVFP4 (download-image --tier nvfp4), 4 steps, CFG 1.0
- flux-2-klein-base-4b-fp8.safetensors — more quality (download-image --tier base), raise steps to 20-28 and CFG to about 3.5

SETTINGS: width/height on EmptyFlux2LatentImage (default 1024x576 16:9). 1:1 = 768x768. 9:16 = 576x1024. Instagram 4:5 = 1024x1280. Seed, steps, CFG on KSampler.
Save prefix: ez_still_app.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used. Turn Enhance off to pin the widget text.

Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/still-daily from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.text:

Other choices
