Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 4

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: klein/creator/pinterest-pin
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded klein/creator/pinterest-pin from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/klein/creator/pinterest-pin.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/creator/pinterest-pin

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Pinterest standard pin 2:3. Lab size **768×1152**. Prefix `ez_pin`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/creator/pinterest-pin from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 4

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

How it affects generation: 1.0 is full generation (T2I / T2V / ACE). Values below 1 keep structure from an encoded start image (Klein edit / clay). Lab I2V uses dedicated latent nodes, not denoise<1 on empty noise.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/creator/pinterest-story

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Pinterest Idea Pin 9:16. Lab size **576×1024**. Prefix `ez_pin_story`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/creator/pinterest-story from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.text:

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.text:

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 4

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: klein/creator/poster-portrait
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded klein/creator/poster-portrait from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/klein/creator/poster-portrait.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/creator/poster-portrait

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Print poster 2:3. Lab size **768×1152**. Prefix `ez_poster`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/creator/poster-portrait from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 4

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: denoise
docs.text:

How it affects generation: 1.0 is full generation (T2I / T2V / ACE). Values below 1 keep structure from an encoded start image (Klein edit / clay). Lab I2V uses dedicated latent nodes, not denoise<1 on empty noise.

What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded klein/creator/product-lifestyle from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/klein/creator/product-lifestyle.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/creator/product-lifestyle

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

In-use product lifestyle 4:5. Lab size **1024×1280**. Prefix `ez_lifestyle`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Handoff: **wan/creator/unbox-hands**.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/creator/product-lifestyle from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.text:

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 4

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: klein/creator/slide-title
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded klein/creator/slide-title from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/klein/creator/slide-title.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/creator/slide-title

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Course / webinar title plate 16:9. Lab size **1280×720**. Prefix `ez_slide`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/creator/slide-title from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 8

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: denoise
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–1; lab 1.0.

Fraction of the latent to replace with denoised signal.

How it affects generation: 1.0 is full generation (T2I / T2V / ACE). Values below 1 keep structure from an encoded start image (Klein edit / clay). Lab I2V uses dedicated latent nodes, not denoise<1 on empty noise.

This graph: 1.0

What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note

Who this is for: studio users who loaded klein/creator/spotify-canvas-still from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/klein/creator/spotify-canvas-still.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/creator/spotify-canvas-still

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Spotify Canvas still 9:16 (silent JPG stand-in). Lab size **576×1024**. Prefix `ez_spot_still`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Handoff: **wan/creator/spotify-canvas**.
Spotify Canvas is silent 9:16, 3–8 s, MP4 or JPG. Scale in an editor if the current Canvas pixel range rejects this height.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/creator/spotify-canvas-still from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 4

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: klein/creator/spotify-playlist
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded klein/creator/spotify-playlist from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/klein/creator/spotify-playlist.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/creator/spotify-playlist

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Spotify playlist cover 1:1. Lab size **1024×1024**. Prefix `ez_spot_pl`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/creator/spotify-playlist from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 8

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)

Who this is for: studio users who loaded klein/creator/substack-hero from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/klein/creator/substack-hero.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/creator/substack-hero

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Substack / blog hero ~1.91:1. Lab size **1216×640**. Prefix `ez_substack`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/creator/substack-hero from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

Other choices

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 8

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: klein/creator/threads-portrait
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded klein/creator/threads-portrait from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/klein/creator/threads-portrait.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/creator/threads-portrait

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Threads 4:5 still. Lab size **1024×1280**. Prefix `ez_threads`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/creator/threads-portrait from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 4

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

What's on this page

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/creator/tiktok-cover

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

TikTok cover 9:16. Lab size **576×1024**. Prefix `ez_tt_cover`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Handoff: **wan/creator/tiktok-hook**, **ltx/creator/tiktok-broll**.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/creator/tiktok-cover from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded klein/creator/tiktok-shop from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/klein/creator/tiktok-shop.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy klein. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## klein/creator/tiktok-shop

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

TikTok Shop packshot 1:1. Lab size **1024×1024**. Prefix `ez_tt_shop`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: klein — stop Wan, LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Handoff: **wan/creator/product-spin**.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load klein/creator/tiktok-shop from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.text:

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 8

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
