docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 25

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

## ltx/weather-broll

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

LTX canvas 1280x704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid).

Weather B-roll AV (~5 s T2V). LTX-2.5 distilled. Community License — not Apache.
Prefix `ez_weather_video`. World audio muxed into MP4.

After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview** for an inline preview. File lands on the host at `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_*_*.mp4` (container `/outputs`). Save frames PNG is secondary.
Disclose AI-generated media. No score.

Occupancy: ltx — stop Wan, podcast, music, other LTX. One GB10 job.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: ltx/creator/asmr-macro
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded ltx/creator/asmr-macro from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/ltx/creator/asmr-macro.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy ltx. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## ltx/creator/asmr-macro

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Quiet macro foley AV ~5 s. Lab size **1280×704**. Prefix `ez_asmr`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: ltx — stop Wan, podcast, music, other LTX. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview**. File lands on `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
LoadImage defaults to example.png so Queue smokes.
LTX canvas 1280×704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid). Disclose AI-generated media. No score. Mouths will not match.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load ltx/creator/asmr-macro from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 20

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: denoise
docs.text:

Fraction of the latent to replace with denoised signal.

How it affects generation: 1.0 is full generation (T2I / T2V / ACE). Values below 1 keep structure from an encoded start image (Klein edit / clay). Lab I2V uses dedicated latent nodes, not denoise<1 on empty noise.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: ltx/creator/crowd-ambience
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded ltx/creator/crowd-ambience from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/ltx/creator/crowd-ambience.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy ltx. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## ltx/creator/crowd-ambience

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Distant crowd bed AV ~5 s. Lab size **1280×704**. Prefix `ez_crowd`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: ltx — stop Wan, podcast, music, other LTX. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview**. File lands on `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
LoadImage defaults to example.png so Queue smokes.
LTX canvas 1280×704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid). Disclose AI-generated media. No score. Mouths will not match.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load ltx/creator/crowd-ambience from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 25

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

## ltx/creator/crowd-ambience

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Distant crowd bed AV ~5 s. Lab size **1280×704**. Prefix `ez_crowd`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: ltx — stop Wan, podcast, music, other LTX. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview**. File lands on `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
LoadImage defaults to example.png so Queue smokes.
LTX canvas 1280×704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid). Disclose AI-generated media. No score. Mouths will not match.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: ltx/creator/desk-work
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded ltx/creator/desk-work from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/ltx/creator/desk-work.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy ltx. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## ltx/creator/desk-work

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Desk / keyboard room-tone AV ~5 s. Lab size **1280×704**. Prefix `ez_desk_av`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: ltx — stop Wan, podcast, music, other LTX. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview**. File lands on `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
LoadImage defaults to example.png so Queue smokes.
LTX canvas 1280×704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid). Disclose AI-generated media. No score. Mouths will not match.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load ltx/creator/desk-work from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 25

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: denoise
docs.text:

Fraction of the latent to replace with denoised signal.

How it affects generation: 1.0 is full generation (T2I / T2V / ACE). Values below 1 keep structure from an encoded start image (Klein edit / clay). Lab I2V uses dedicated latent nodes, not denoise<1 on empty noise.

This graph: 1.0

## ltx/creator/desk-work

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Desk / keyboard room-tone AV ~5 s. Lab size **1280×704**. Prefix `ez_desk_av`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: ltx — stop Wan, podcast, music, other LTX. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview**. File lands on `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
LoadImage defaults to example.png so Queue smokes.
LTX canvas 1280×704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid). Disclose AI-generated media. No score. Mouths will not match.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: frame_rate
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: lab 24 (GIF 12/16).

Output frames per second.

How it affects generation: 24 fps is the lab motion/AV printer. GIF loops use 12. Changing fps without changing frame count changes duration.

This graph: 24

docs.title: loop_count
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 = infinite in players that honor it.

How many times the file loops.

How it affects generation: 0 is the lab default (play once / player default).

This graph: 0

Pixel format for H.264.

docs.title: crf
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: lab 18.

H.264 constant-rate-factor. Lower is bigger/cleaner.

How it affects generation: 18 is the lab visually-lossless-ish setting. Raising CRF shrinks files and adds blockiness.

This graph: 18

docs.title: save_metadata
docs.text:

Embed workflow JSON in the file.

How it affects generation: true keeps provenance on the MP4.

This graph: true

docs.title: trim_to_audio

Cut picture to audio length.

How it affects generation: Lab false except when you mean to lock to a bed. ltx/a2v muxes the original wav instead.

docs.title: pingpong
docs.text:

Play frames forward then reverse.

How it affects generation: true on wan/gif-loop, bumper-loop, sticker-loop. false on 5 s narrative prints.

This graph: false

docs.title: save_output

Write the file to disk.

How it affects generation: Lab video graphs require true. After Queue, open the node for the inline preview.

This graph: true

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 20

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

Fraction of the latent to replace with denoised signal.

How it affects generation: 1.0 is full generation (T2I / T2V / ACE). Values below 1 keep structure from an encoded start image (Klein edit / clay). Lab I2V uses dedicated latent nodes, not denoise<1 on empty noise.

This graph: 1.0

## ltx/creator/fashion-turn

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Fashion turn AV 9:16. Lab size **768×1280**. Prefix `ez_turn`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: ltx — stop Wan, podcast, music, other LTX. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview**. File lands on `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
LoadImage defaults to example.png so Queue smokes.
LTX canvas 768×1280 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid). Disclose AI-generated media. No score. Mouths will not match.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: ltx/creator/fireplace
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded ltx/creator/fireplace from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/ltx/creator/fireplace.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy ltx. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## ltx/creator/fireplace

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Fireplace AV ~5 s. Lab size **1280×704**. Prefix `ez_fire`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: ltx — stop Wan, podcast, music, other LTX. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview**. File lands on `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
LoadImage defaults to example.png so Queue smokes.
LTX canvas 1280×704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid). Disclose AI-generated media. No score. Mouths will not match.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load ltx/creator/fireplace from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 25

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. ## ltx/creator/fireplace

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Fireplace AV ~5 s. Lab size **1280×704**. Prefix `ez_fire`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: ltx — stop Wan, podcast, music, other LTX. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview**. File lands on `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
LoadImage defaults to example.png so Queue smokes.
LTX canvas 1280×704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid). Disclose AI-generated media. No score. Mouths will not match.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

Occupancy: ltx — stop Wan, podcast, music, other LTX. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview**. File lands on `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
LoadImage defaults to example.png so Queue smokes.
LTX canvas 768×1280 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid). Disclose AI-generated media. No score. Mouths will not match.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load ltx/creator/instagram-reel-lifestyle from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: UNETLoader — Load Diffusion Model
docs.text:
Load a standalone transformer/UNET from diffusion_models/.

Lab notes

Lab files: flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors, wan2.2_ti2v_5B_fp16.safetensors, ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors. weight_dtype stays default.

Socket Dir Type What it carries MODEL out MODEL Denoiser weights.

docs.title: unet_name
docs.text:
Type STRING.

Checkpoint filename under MODELS_DIR diffusion_models.

How it affects generation: Wrong family = Queue error or a melted picture. Do not swap Klein 9B / FLUX.2-dev / MiniMax.

This graph: ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors

docs.title: weight_dtype
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: default.

How it affects generation: default keeps the file's dtype (Klein FP8, LTX INT8-convrot, Wan FP16).

This graph: default

Other choices

Choice What it does default Load weights as stored. Lab UNETLoader always uses this. fp8_e4m3fn Cast to FP8 e4m3fn. Can save memory; may shift Klein/LTX quality. fp8_e4m3fn_fast FP8 e4m3fn with fast optimizations. fp8_e5m2 Cast to FP8 e5m2.

docs.text:

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 20

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: denoise
docs.text:

Fraction of the latent to replace with denoised signal.

How it affects generation: 1.0 is full generation (T2I / T2V / ACE). Values below 1 keep structure from an encoded start image (Klein edit / clay). Lab I2V uses dedicated latent nodes, not denoise<1 on empty noise.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: ltx/creator/interior-walk
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded ltx/creator/interior-walk from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/ltx/creator/interior-walk.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy ltx. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## ltx/creator/interior-walk

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Interior walk-through AV ~5 s. Lab size **1280×704**. Prefix `ez_walk`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: ltx — stop Wan, podcast, music, other LTX. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview**. File lands on `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
LoadImage defaults to example.png so Queue smokes.
LTX canvas 1280×704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid). Disclose AI-generated media. No score. Mouths will not match.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load ltx/creator/interior-walk from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 25

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

## ltx/creator/interior-walk

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Interior walk-through AV ~5 s. Lab size **1280×704**. Prefix `ez_walk`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: ltx — stop Wan, podcast, music, other LTX. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview**. File lands on `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
LoadImage defaults to example.png so Queue smokes.
LTX canvas 1280×704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid). Disclose AI-generated media. No score. Mouths will not match.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

What's on this page

Who this is for: studio users who loaded ltx/creator/music-visual from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/ltx/creator/music-visual.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy ltx. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## ltx/creator/music-visual

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Light / particle visualizer bed AV ~5 s. Lab size **1280×704**. Prefix `ez_music_vis`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: ltx — stop Wan, podcast, music, other LTX. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview**. File lands on `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
LoadImage defaults to example.png so Queue smokes.
LTX canvas 1280×704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid). Disclose AI-generated media. No score. Mouths will not match.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load ltx/creator/music-visual from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 25

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: denoise
docs.text:

Fraction of the latent to replace with denoised signal.

How it affects generation: 1.0 is full generation (T2I / T2V / ACE). Values below 1 keep structure from an encoded start image (Klein edit / clay). Lab I2V uses dedicated latent nodes, not denoise<1 on empty noise.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: ltx/creator/podcast-set
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded ltx/creator/podcast-set from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/ltx/creator/podcast-set.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy ltx. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## ltx/creator/podcast-set

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Podcast-set AV ~5 s. Lab size **1280×704**. Prefix `ez_pod_set`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: ltx — stop Wan, podcast, music, other LTX. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview**. File lands on `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
LoadImage defaults to example.png so Queue smokes.
LTX canvas 1280×704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid). Disclose AI-generated media. No score. Mouths will not match.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load ltx/creator/podcast-set from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 25

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

## ltx/creator/podcast-set

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Podcast-set AV ~5 s. Lab size **1280×704**. Prefix `ez_pod_set`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: ltx — stop Wan, podcast, music, other LTX. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview**. File lands on `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
LoadImage defaults to example.png so Queue smokes.
LTX canvas 1280×704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid). Disclose AI-generated media. No score. Mouths will not match.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded ltx/creator/product-unbox-av from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/ltx/creator/product-unbox-av.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy ltx. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## ltx/creator/product-unbox-av

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Unbox AV with paper SFX ~5 s. Lab size **1280×704**. Prefix `ez_unbox_av`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: ltx — stop Wan, podcast, music, other LTX. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview**. File lands on `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
LoadImage defaults to example.png so Queue smokes.
LTX canvas 1280×704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid). Disclose AI-generated media. No score. Mouths will not match.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load ltx/creator/product-unbox-av from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent.
