## shorts/last-lane/act-04

LTX canvas 1280x704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid).

The stitched MP4 is written automatically to `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}` (container `/outputs`) as a faststart H.264 master, plus an HTML sidecar. After Queue, a **Film ready** overlay offers play and download. Per-shot VHS nodes remain for inspection. Optional board: studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

One-click 90s unit (night two-lane · Open gate): Klein identity still + 18 sequential LTX 5.00s AV prints + in-graph stitch.
Models: Klein 4B distilled FP8 (identity still, 4-step, Enhance **off**, t2i mode) · LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot + gemma4 CLIP ltxv + video/audio VAEs (print).
LTX Community License — not Apache. $10M company-revenue cap. Disclose AI-generated media; do not strip provenance; do not distill.

1. Queue **once**. Klein runs first; models unload; then 18 × 5.00s LTX prints chain last-frame → next start.
2. Wall-clock is 18 sequential 5s prints (tens of minutes to a couple of hours on GB10) — expected, not a hang.
3. The MP4 is already on disk at `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_lastlane_90s.mp4` (act graphs write `ez_lastlane_actN_90s.mp4`). A **Film ready** overlay plays it. Copy off the Spark with scp.
4. Optional single-shot iterate: **ltx/still-to-shot**. Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**.
5. Spark-farm / host stitch fallback: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film last-lane --yes`

Do not Queue a 90s denoise (keep 121-frame / 1+8n widgets). US-safe local pack only. No score.
Prompt enhance is **off** so the pinned identity and each baked LTX I2V paragraph are encoded as written. The identity STRING is wired into each shot enhance as context (used only if you turn Enhance on).

This graph is **act 4/5** of a 7.5 min film (90 × 5.00s). Act 4 LoadImage should be the previous act last frame (ez_lastlane_b18_s3_last_*.png). In-graph stitch writes `ez_lastlane_act4_90s.mp4`. After all five acts: `concat-shots.sh --film last-lane --yes` → `ez_lastlane_450s.mp4`.

Occupancy: film — stop everything else on that Spark. One GB10 job.

## last-lane (night two-lane · Open gate)

Queue **once**. Klein identity still → 18 × 5.00s LTX AV prints (last-frame continuity) → **Save 90s film (MP4)**. Do not Queue a 90s denoise (121 frames = 1+8n per shot). **Identity look:** A dashboard first-person still at night on an unmarked two-lane. Dusty cracked dash, blank matte-black gloves on an unmarked wheel along the bottom edge, empty palms, headlight cone on pale gravel and sage. No vehicle badges, empty of lettering. | Beat | Place | s1 | s2 | s3 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Hard pack | Faster gravel tick | The wheel is still | A rise of black mesa |
| 2 | Mesa | The mesa is a wall | The lane skirts it | A pull-out of dirt |
| 3 | Pull-out | The wheel does not take it | The mesa ends | More lane |
| 4 | More lane | A second wash, dry | Cross | The cone finds a gate, unmarked, open |
| 5 | Open gate | No sign on the gate | Through | The lane is the same |
| 6 | Same lane | Dawn is a rumour | Gloves stay | The pale grows |

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy film. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## shorts/last-lane/act-05

LTX canvas 1280x704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid).

The stitched MP4 is written automatically to `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}` (container `/outputs`) as a faststart H.264 master, plus an HTML sidecar. After Queue, a **Film ready** overlay offers play and download. Per-shot VHS nodes remain for inspection. Optional board: studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

One-click 90s unit (night two-lane · Dawn dash): Klein identity still + 18 sequential LTX 5.00s AV prints + in-graph stitch.
Models: Klein 4B distilled FP8 (identity still, 4-step, Enhance **off**, t2i mode) · LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot + gemma4 CLIP ltxv + video/audio VAEs (print).
LTX Community License — not Apache. $10M company-revenue cap. Disclose AI-generated media; do not strip provenance; do not distill.

1. Queue **once**. Klein runs first; models unload; then 18 × 5.00s LTX prints chain last-frame → next start.
2. Wall-clock is 18 sequential 5s prints (tens of minutes to a couple of hours on GB10) — expected, not a hang.
3. The MP4 is already on disk at `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_lastlane_90s.mp4` (act graphs write `ez_lastlane_actN_90s.mp4`). A **Film ready** overlay plays it. Copy off the Spark with scp.
4. Optional single-shot iterate: **ltx/still-to-shot**. Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**.
5. Spark-farm / host stitch fallback: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film last-lane --yes`

Do not Queue a 90s denoise (keep 121-frame / 1+8n widgets). US-safe local pack only. No score.
Prompt enhance is **off** so the pinned identity and each baked LTX I2V paragraph are encoded as written. The identity STRING is wired into each shot enhance as context (used only if you turn Enhance on).

This graph is **act 5/5** of a 7.5 min film (90 × 5.00s). Act 5 LoadImage should be the previous act last frame (ez_lastlane_b24_s3_last_*.png). In-graph stitch writes `ez_lastlane_act5_90s.mp4`. After all five acts: `concat-shots.sh --film last-lane --yes` → `ez_lastlane_450s.mp4`.

Occupancy: film — stop everything else on that Spark. One GB10 job.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load shorts/last-lane/act-05 from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: Node parameter reference
docs.text: Every unique node type on this graph. Widgets are in lab JSON order. Choices are ComfyUI v0.34.6 / lab INPUT_TYPES — not SD1.5 folklore.

docs.title: UNETLoader — Load Diffusion Model
docs.text:
Load a standalone transformer/UNET from diffusion_models/.

Lab notes

Lab files: flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors, wan2.2_ti2v_5B_fp16.safetensors, ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors. weight_dtype stays default.

Socket Dir Type What it carries MODEL out MODEL Denoiser weights.

docs.title: unet_name
docs.text:
Type STRING.

Checkpoint filename under MODELS_DIR diffusion_models.

How it affects generation: Wrong family = Queue error or a melted picture. Do not swap Klein 9B / FLUX.2-dev / MiniMax.

Instance Value Klein 4B distilled FP8 flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors

docs.title: weight_dtype
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: default.

Cast at load.

How it affects generation: default keeps the file's dtype (Klein FP8, LTX INT8-convrot, Wan FP16).

This graph (all 2 instances): default

Other choices

Choice What it does default Load weights as stored. Lab UNETLoader always uses this. fp8_e4m3fn Cast to FP8 e4m3fn. Can save memory; may shift Klein/LTX quality. fp8_e4m3fn_fast FP8 e4m3fn with fast optimizations. fp8_e5m2 Cast to FP8 e5m2.

docs.title: CLIPLoader — Load CLIP
docs.text:
Load a text encoder. The type combo must match the UNET family.

Lab notes

Lab types: flux2 (Qwen3-4B), wan (UMT5), ltxv (Gemma4-with-proj). Wrong type is a Queue error, not a bad prompt. MiniMax type is banned.

Socket Dir Type What it carries CLIP out CLIP Text encoder for CLIPTextEncode / ACE / LTX.

docs.title: clip_name
docs.text:
Type STRING.

Filename under text_encoders.

How it affects generation: Must match the family (qwen_3_4b, umt5_xxl, gemma4-12b-with-proj).

Instance Value Qwen3-4B TE qwen_3_4b.safetensors Gemma4-with-proj (ltxv) gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors

docs.title: type
docs.text:
Type COMBO.

CLIPType enum. Picks tokenizer + template.

How it affects generation: flux2 wraps Klein strings in a Qwen chat template — do not paste <|im_start|>. wan is UMT5. ltxv is Gemma4-with-proj.

Instance Value Qwen3-4B TE flux2 Gemma4-with-proj (ltxv) ltxv

Other choices

Choice What it does flux2 Klein 4B / Qwen3-4B text encoder. Lab stills. wan Wan 2.2 UMT5-XXL. Lab silent motion. ltxv LTX-2.5 Gemma4-with-proj. Lab AV. ace ACE-Step text encoder. Music graphs use CheckpointLoaderSimple instead. stable_diffusion SD1.x CLIP. Not a lab default. stable_cascade Stable Cascade CLIP. sd3 SD3 CLIP stack. stable_audio Stable Audio T5. mochi Mochi T5. pixart PixArt. cosmos Cosmos T5. lumina2 Lumina-2 Gemma. hidream HiDream. chroma Chroma. omnigen2 OmniGen2. qwen_image Qwen-Image. hunyuan_image Hunyuan image. ovis Ovis. longcat_image LongCat image. Optional stub only. cogvideox CogVideoX T5. lens Lens. pixeldit PixelDit. ideogram4 Ideogram. boogu Boogu. krea2 Krea. joyimage JoyImage Qwen3-VL. mage Mage. minimax MiniMax. Banned in this studio (US Excluded Territory). Do not pick.

docs.title: device
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: default.

Where to load the encoder.

How it affects generation: default uses GPU. cpu is a debug escape hatch.

This graph (all 2 instances): default

Other choices

Choice What it does default Load on the Comfy compute device (GPU). Lab default. cpu Force CPU. Much slower; only for debugging a CLIP load.

docs.title: VAELoader — Load VAE
docs.text:
Load the autoencoder that maps pixels ↔ latents (and LTX audio).

Lab notes

Do not mix families: flux2-vae, wan2.2_vae, ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16, ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.

Socket Dir Type What it carries VAE out VAE Encoder/decoder.

docs.text:
Type STRING.

Filename under vae/.

How it affects generation: Wrong VAE = color trash or a shape error.

docs.title: CLIPTextEncode — CLIP Text Encode
docs.text:
Turn a prompt string into CONDITIONING for the sampler.

Lab notes

The dim CLIP box after Queue is this string. Prompt Enhance nodes rewrite it when Enhance is on.

Socket Dir Type What it carries clip in CLIP Matching family encoder. text in STRING Often wired from Prompt Enhance so the widget is a preview. CONDITIONING out CONDITIONING Positive or negative cond.

docs.title: text

## shorts/last-lane/act-05

LTX canvas 1280x704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid).

The stitched MP4 is written automatically to `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}` (container `/outputs`) as a faststart H.264 master, plus an HTML sidecar. After Queue, a **Film ready** overlay offers play and download. Per-shot VHS nodes remain for inspection. Optional board: studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

One-click 90s unit (night two-lane · Dawn dash): Klein identity still + 18 sequential LTX 5.00s AV prints + in-graph stitch.
Models: Klein 4B distilled FP8 (identity still, 4-step, Enhance **off**, t2i mode) · LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot + gemma4 CLIP ltxv + video/audio VAEs (print).
LTX Community License — not Apache. $10M company-revenue cap. Disclose AI-generated media; do not strip provenance; do not distill.

1. Queue **once**. Klein runs first; models unload; then 18 × 5.00s LTX prints chain last-frame → next start.
2. Wall-clock is 18 sequential 5s prints (tens of minutes to a couple of hours on GB10) — expected, not a hang.
3. The MP4 is already on disk at `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_lastlane_90s.mp4` (act graphs write `ez_lastlane_actN_90s.mp4`). A **Film ready** overlay plays it. Copy off the Spark with scp.
4. Optional single-shot iterate: **ltx/still-to-shot**. Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**.
5. Spark-farm / host stitch fallback: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film last-lane --yes`

Do not Queue a 90s denoise (keep 121-frame / 1+8n widgets). US-safe local pack only. No score.
Prompt enhance is **off** so the pinned identity and each baked LTX I2V paragraph are encoded as written. The identity STRING is wired into each shot enhance as context (used only if you turn Enhance on).

This graph is **act 5/5** of a 7.5 min film (90 × 5.00s). Act 5 LoadImage should be the previous act last frame (ez_lastlane_b24_s3_last_*.png). In-graph stitch writes `ez_lastlane_act5_90s.mp4`. After all five acts: `concat-shots.sh --film last-lane --yes` → `ez_lastlane_450s.mp4`.

Occupancy: film — stop everything else on that Spark. One GB10 job.

This graph: ## last-lane (night two-lane · Dawn dash) Queue **once**. Klein identity still → 18 × 5.00s LTX AV prints (last-frame continuity) → **Save 90s film (MP4)**. Do not Queue a 90s denoise (121 frames = 1…

## last-lane (night two-lane · Dawn dash)

Queue **once**. Klein identity still → 18 × 5.00s LTX AV prints (last-frame continuity) → **Save 90s film (MP4)**. Do not Queue a 90s denoise (121 frames = 1+8n per shot). Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**. Optional host stitch: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film last-lane --yes`.

18 × 121 frames @ 24 fps (LTX 1+8n) stitch under a 90.00s cap. US-safe local pack only. No score. Play/download: overlay, `ez_*_90s.html`, or studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

**Identity look:** A dashboard first-person still at night on an unmarked two-lane. Dusty cracked dash, blank matte-black gloves on an unmarked wheel along the bottom edge, empty palms, headlight cone on pale gravel and sage. No vehicle badges, empty of lettering. Match a standing eyeline. 24mm-equivalent wide, framed for YouTube 16:9, mild film grain, clean unmarked lens.

| Beat | Place | s1 | s2 | s3 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | More pale | Sage goes from black to grey | The cone weakens | Day wants the dash |
| 2 | Day dash | Dust on the dash in grey | The wheel is clearer | No badges still |
| 3 | Blank wheel | The lane keeps | A last night bug on the glass | The bug is gone |
| 4 | Clean glass | Dawn on unmarked country | Gloves at rest on the wheel | The cone is nothing |
| 5 | Daylight ruts | The two-lane in first sun | A hold on the gloves | The dash in sun |
| 6 | Close | Blank gloves on the unmarked wheel | The country goes gold | The frame holds the dash and the lane |
Prompt enhance is **off** so authored text (recipe, script labels, ACE tags, or film shots) is encoded as written. Turn Enhance on only if you want the 4B rewriter.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy film. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## shorts/night-oven/act-01

LTX canvas 1280x704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid).

The stitched MP4 is written automatically to `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}` (container `/outputs`) as a faststart H.264 master, plus an HTML sidecar. After Queue, a **Film ready** overlay offers play and download. Per-shot VHS nodes remain for inspection. Optional board: studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

One-click 90s unit (overnight bakery · Tie the apron): Klein identity still + 18 sequential LTX 5.00s AV prints + in-graph stitch.
Models: Klein 4B distilled FP8 (identity still, 4-step, Enhance **off**, t2i mode) · LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot + gemma4 CLIP ltxv + video/audio VAEs (print).
LTX Community License — not Apache. $10M company-revenue cap. Disclose AI-generated media; do not strip provenance; do not distill.

1. Queue **once**. Klein runs first; models unload; then 18 × 5.00s LTX prints chain last-frame → next start.
2. Wall-clock is 18 sequential 5s prints (tens of minutes to a couple of hours on GB10) — expected, not a hang.
3. The MP4 is already on disk at `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_nightoven_90s.mp4` (act graphs write `ez_nightoven_actN_90s.mp4`). A **Film ready** overlay plays it. Copy off the Spark with scp.
4. Optional single-shot iterate: **ltx/still-to-shot**. Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**.
5. Spark-farm / host stitch fallback: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes`

Do not Queue a 90s denoise (keep 121-frame / 1+8n widgets). US-safe local pack only. No score.
Prompt enhance is **off** so the pinned identity and each baked LTX I2V paragraph are encoded as written. The identity STRING is wired into each shot enhance as context (used only if you turn Enhance on).

This graph is **act 1/5** of a 7.5 min film (90 × 5.00s). Act 1 starts from Klein identity. In-graph stitch writes `ez_nightoven_act1_90s.mp4`. After all five acts: `concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes` → `ez_nightoven_450s.mp4`.

Occupancy: film — stop everything else on that Spark. One GB10 job.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load shorts/night-oven/act-01 from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. ## shorts/night-oven/act-01

LTX canvas 1280x704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid).

The stitched MP4 is written automatically to `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}` (container `/outputs`) as a faststart H.264 master, plus an HTML sidecar. After Queue, a **Film ready** overlay offers play and download. Per-shot VHS nodes remain for inspection. Optional board: studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

One-click 90s unit (overnight bakery · Tie the apron): Klein identity still + 18 sequential LTX 5.00s AV prints + in-graph stitch.
Models: Klein 4B distilled FP8 (identity still, 4-step, Enhance **off**, t2i mode) · LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot + gemma4 CLIP ltxv + video/audio VAEs (print).
LTX Community License — not Apache. $10M company-revenue cap. Disclose AI-generated media; do not strip provenance; do not distill.

1. Queue **once**. Klein runs first; models unload; then 18 × 5.00s LTX prints chain last-frame → next start.
2. Wall-clock is 18 sequential 5s prints (tens of minutes to a couple of hours on GB10) — expected, not a hang.
3. The MP4 is already on disk at `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_nightoven_90s.mp4` (act graphs write `ez_nightoven_actN_90s.mp4`). A **Film ready** overlay plays it. Copy off the Spark with scp.
4. Optional single-shot iterate: **ltx/still-to-shot**. Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**.
5. Spark-farm / host stitch fallback: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes`

Do not Queue a 90s denoise (keep 121-frame / 1+8n widgets). US-safe local pack only. No score.
Prompt enhance is **off** so the pinned identity and each baked LTX I2V paragraph are encoded as written. The identity STRING is wired into each shot enhance as context (used only if you turn Enhance on).

This graph is **act 1/5** of a 7.5 min film (90 × 5.00s). Act 1 starts from Klein identity. In-graph stitch writes `ez_nightoven_act1_90s.mp4`. After all five acts: `concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes` → `ez_nightoven_450s.mp4`.

Occupancy: film — stop everything else on that Spark. One GB10 job.

Type STRING.

Markdown body.

How it affects generation: Does not affect pixels. 90s films put the beat table here.

This graph: ## night-oven (overnight bakery · Tie the apron) Queue **once**. Klein identity still → 18 × 5.00s LTX AV prints (last-frame continuity) → **Save 90s film (MP4)**. Do not Queue a 90s denoise (121 fra…

## night-oven (overnight bakery · Tie the apron)

Queue **once**. Klein identity still → 18 × 5.00s LTX AV prints (last-frame continuity) → **Save 90s film (MP4)**. Do not Queue a 90s denoise (121 frames = 1+8n per shot). Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**. Optional host stitch: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes`.

18 × 121 frames @ 24 fps (LTX 1+8n) stitch under a 90.00s cap. US-safe local pack only. No score. Play/download: overlay, `ez_*_90s.html`, or studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

**Identity look:** A photoreal third-person bakery still at 2 a.m. A flour-dusted linen apron hangs on a steel bench in the foreground, unmarked mixer bowls and a dark oven mouth behind. Warm tungsten versus a sodium alley through one high window. Match a standing eyeline. 35mm-equivalent classic, framed for YouTube 16:9, empty of lettering, mild film grain, clean unmarked lens.

| Beat | Place | s1 | s2 | s3 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Bench | The apron hangs still in tungsten | A hand lifts the apron | The apron is tied |
| 2 | Tie | The knot sits at the waist | Flour dust lifts | The bench is empty |
| 3 | Empty steel | Bowls wait unmarked | A pour of water | A mixer starts |
| 4 | Mixer | The bowl turns slow | A scrape of the hook | The mixer stops |
| 5 | Dough | Hands fold the dough | A dust of flour | The dough rests |
| 6 | Rest | The oven mouth is dark | A match of warmth | The door opens |
Prompt enhance is **off** so authored text (recipe, script labels, ACE tags, or film shots) is encoded as written. Turn Enhance on only if you want the 4B rewriter.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy film. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## shorts/night-oven/act-02

LTX canvas 1280x704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid).

The stitched MP4 is written automatically to `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}` (container `/outputs`) as a faststart H.264 master, plus an HTML sidecar. After Queue, a **Film ready** overlay offers play and download. Per-shot VHS nodes remain for inspection. Optional board: studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

One-click 90s unit (overnight bakery · Heat): Klein identity still + 18 sequential LTX 5.00s AV prints + in-graph stitch.
Models: Klein 4B distilled FP8 (identity still, 4-step, Enhance **off**, t2i mode) · LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot + gemma4 CLIP ltxv + video/audio VAEs (print).
LTX Community License — not Apache. $10M company-revenue cap. Disclose AI-generated media; do not strip provenance; do not distill.

1. Queue **once**. Klein runs first; models unload; then 18 × 5.00s LTX prints chain last-frame → next start.
2. Wall-clock is 18 sequential 5s prints (tens of minutes to a couple of hours on GB10) — expected, not a hang.
3. The MP4 is already on disk at `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_nightoven_90s.mp4` (act graphs write `ez_nightoven_actN_90s.mp4`). A **Film ready** overlay plays it. Copy off the Spark with scp.
4. Optional single-shot iterate: **ltx/still-to-shot**. Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**.
5. Spark-farm / host stitch fallback: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes`

Do not Queue a 90s denoise (keep 121-frame / 1+8n widgets). US-safe local pack only. No score.
Prompt enhance is **off** so the pinned identity and each baked LTX I2V paragraph are encoded as written. The identity STRING is wired into each shot enhance as context (used only if you turn Enhance on).

This graph is **act 2/5** of a 7.5 min film (90 × 5.00s). Act 2 LoadImage should be the previous act last frame (ez_nightoven_b6_s3_last_*.png). In-graph stitch writes `ez_nightoven_act2_90s.mp4`. After all five acts: `concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes` → `ez_nightoven_450s.mp4`.

Occupancy: film — stop everything else on that Spark. One GB10 job.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load shorts/night-oven/act-02 from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: UNETLoader — Load Diffusion Model

Lab notes

docs.text:

docs.text:

docs.text:

Lab notes

Socket Dir Type What it carries LATENT out LATENT Noise canvas for KSampler.

docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: lab 768 / 1280 / 1024 / 432….

Latent pixel width.

This graph: 1280

docs.text:

Latent pixel height.

How many stills in one Queue.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

Instance Value KSampler 42 KSampler 60 KSampler 61 KSampler 62 KSampler 63 KSampler 64 KSampler 65 KSampler 66 KSampler 67 KSampler 68 KSampler 69 KSampler 70 KSampler 71 KSampler 72 KSampler 73 KSampler 74 KSampler 75 KSampler 76 KSampler 77

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph (all 19 instances): fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

Instance Value KSampler 4 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph (all 19 instances): 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph (all 19 instances): euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph (all 19 instances): simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: denoise
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–1; lab 1.0.

Fraction of the latent to replace with denoised signal.

How it affects generation: 1.0 is full generation (T2I / T2V / ACE). Values below 1 keep structure from an encoded start image (Klein edit / clay). Lab I2V uses dedicated latent nodes, not denoise<1 on empty noise.

## shorts/night-oven/act-02

LTX canvas 1280x704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid).

The stitched MP4 is written automatically to `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}` (container `/outputs`) as a faststart H.264 master, plus an HTML sidecar. After Queue, a **Film ready** overlay offers play and download. Per-shot VHS nodes remain for inspection. Optional board: studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

One-click 90s unit (overnight bakery · Heat): Klein identity still + 18 sequential LTX 5.00s AV prints + in-graph stitch.
Models: Klein 4B distilled FP8 (identity still, 4-step, Enhance **off**, t2i mode) · LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot + gemma4 CLIP ltxv + video/audio VAEs (print).
LTX Community License — not Apache. $10M company-revenue cap. Disclose AI-generated media; do not strip provenance; do not distill.

1. Queue **once**. Klein runs first; models unload; then 18 × 5.00s LTX prints chain last-frame → next start.
2. Wall-clock is 18 sequential 5s prints (tens of minutes to a couple of hours on GB10) — expected, not a hang.
3. The MP4 is already on disk at `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_nightoven_90s.mp4` (act graphs write `ez_nightoven_actN_90s.mp4`). A **Film ready** overlay plays it. Copy off the Spark with scp.
4. Optional single-shot iterate: **ltx/still-to-shot**. Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**.
5. Spark-farm / host stitch fallback: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes`

Do not Queue a 90s denoise (keep 121-frame / 1+8n widgets). US-safe local pack only. No score.
Prompt enhance is **off** so the pinned identity and each baked LTX I2V paragraph are encoded as written. The identity STRING is wired into each shot enhance as context (used only if you turn Enhance on).

This graph is **act 2/5** of a 7.5 min film (90 × 5.00s). Act 2 LoadImage should be the previous act last frame (ez_nightoven_b6_s3_last_*.png). In-graph stitch writes `ez_nightoven_act2_90s.mp4`. After all five acts: `concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes` → `ez_nightoven_450s.mp4`.

Occupancy: film — stop everything else on that Spark. One GB10 job.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy film. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## shorts/night-oven/act-03

LTX canvas 1280x704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid).

The stitched MP4 is written automatically to `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}` (container `/outputs`) as a faststart H.264 master, plus an HTML sidecar. After Queue, a **Film ready** overlay offers play and download. Per-shot VHS nodes remain for inspection. Optional board: studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

One-click 90s unit (overnight bakery · Gold loaves): Klein identity still + 18 sequential LTX 5.00s AV prints + in-graph stitch.
Models: Klein 4B distilled FP8 (identity still, 4-step, Enhance **off**, t2i mode) · LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot + gemma4 CLIP ltxv + video/audio VAEs (print).
LTX Community License — not Apache. $10M company-revenue cap. Disclose AI-generated media; do not strip provenance; do not distill.

1. Queue **once**. Klein runs first; models unload; then 18 × 5.00s LTX prints chain last-frame → next start.
2. Wall-clock is 18 sequential 5s prints (tens of minutes to a couple of hours on GB10) — expected, not a hang.
3. The MP4 is already on disk at `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_nightoven_90s.mp4` (act graphs write `ez_nightoven_actN_90s.mp4`). A **Film ready** overlay plays it. Copy off the Spark with scp.
4. Optional single-shot iterate: **ltx/still-to-shot**. Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**.
5. Spark-farm / host stitch fallback: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes`

Do not Queue a 90s denoise (keep 121-frame / 1+8n widgets). US-safe local pack only. No score.
Prompt enhance is **off** so the pinned identity and each baked LTX I2V paragraph are encoded as written. The identity STRING is wired into each shot enhance as context (used only if you turn Enhance on).

This graph is **act 3/5** of a 7.5 min film (90 × 5.00s). Act 3 LoadImage should be the previous act last frame (ez_nightoven_b12_s3_last_*.png). In-graph stitch writes `ez_nightoven_act3_90s.mp4`. After all five acts: `concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes` → `ez_nightoven_450s.mp4`.

Occupancy: film — stop everything else on that Spark. One GB10 job.

docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load shorts/night-oven/act-03 from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: Node parameter reference
docs.text: Every unique node type on this graph. Widgets are in lab JSON order. Choices are ComfyUI v0.34.6 / lab INPUT_TYPES — not SD1.5 folklore.

docs.title: UNETLoader — Load Diffusion Model
docs.text:
Load a standalone transformer/UNET from diffusion_models/.

Lab notes

Lab files: flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors, wan2.2_ti2v_5B_fp16.safetensors, ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors. weight_dtype stays default.

Socket Dir Type What it carries MODEL out MODEL Denoiser weights.

docs.title: unet_name
docs.text:
Type STRING.

Checkpoint filename under MODELS_DIR diffusion_models.

How it affects generation: Wrong family = Queue error or a melted picture. Do not swap Klein 9B / FLUX.2-dev / MiniMax.

Instance Value Klein 4B distilled FP8 flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors

docs.title: weight_dtype
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: default.

Cast at load.

How it affects generation: default keeps the file's dtype (Klein FP8, LTX INT8-convrot, Wan FP16).

This graph (all 2 instances): default

Other choices

Choice What it does default Load weights as stored. Lab UNETLoader always uses this. fp8_e4m3fn Cast to FP8 e4m3fn. Can save memory; may shift Klein/LTX quality. fp8_e4m3fn_fast FP8 e4m3fn with fast optimizations. fp8_e5m2 Cast to FP8 e5m2.

docs.title: CLIPLoader — Load CLIP
docs.text:
Load a text encoder. The type combo must match the UNET family.

Lab notes

Lab types: flux2 (Qwen3-4B), wan (UMT5), ltxv (Gemma4-with-proj). Wrong type is a Queue error, not a bad prompt. MiniMax type is banned.

Socket Dir Type What it carries CLIP out CLIP Text encoder for CLIPTextEncode / ACE / LTX.

docs.title: clip_name
docs.text:
Type STRING.

Filename under text_encoders.

How it affects generation: Must match the family (qwen_3_4b, umt5_xxl, gemma4-12b-with-proj).

Instance Value Qwen3-4B TE qwen_3_4b.safetensors Gemma4-with-proj (ltxv) gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors

docs.title: type
docs.text:
Type COMBO.

CLIPType enum. Picks tokenizer + template.

How it affects generation: flux2 wraps Klein strings in a Qwen chat template — do not paste <|im_start|>. wan is UMT5. ltxv is Gemma4-with-proj.

Instance Value Qwen3-4B TE flux2 Gemma4-with-proj (ltxv) ltxv

Other choices

Choice What it does flux2 Klein 4B / Qwen3-4B text encoder. Lab stills. wan Wan 2.2 UMT5-XXL. Lab silent motion. ltxv LTX-2.5 Gemma4-with-proj. Lab AV. ace ACE-Step text encoder. Music graphs use CheckpointLoaderSimple instead. stable_diffusion SD1.x CLIP. Not a lab default. stable_cascade Stable Cascade CLIP. sd3 SD3 CLIP stack. stable_audio Stable Audio T5. mochi Mochi T5. pixart PixArt. cosmos Cosmos T5. lumina2 Lumina-2 Gemma. hidream HiDream. chroma Chroma. omnigen2 OmniGen2. qwen_image Qwen-Image. hunyuan_image Hunyuan image. ovis Ovis. longcat_image LongCat image. Optional stub only. cogvideox CogVideoX T5. lens Lens. pixeldit PixelDit. ideogram4 Ideogram. boogu Boogu. krea2 Krea. joyimage JoyImage Qwen3-VL. mage Mage. minimax MiniMax. Banned in this studio (US Excluded Territory). Do not pick.

docs.title: device
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: default.

Where to load the encoder.

How it affects generation: default uses GPU. cpu is a debug escape hatch.

This graph (all 2 instances): default

Other choices

Choice What it does default Load on the Comfy compute device (GPU). Lab default. cpu Force CPU. Much slower; only for debugging a CLIP load.

docs.title: VAELoader — Load VAE
docs.text:
Load the autoencoder that maps pixels ↔ latents (and LTX audio).

Lab notes

Do not mix families: flux2-vae, wan2.2_vae, ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16, ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.

Socket Dir Type What it carries VAE out VAE Encoder/decoder.

docs.text:
Type STRING.

Filename under vae/.

How it affects generation: Wrong VAE = color trash or a shape error.

docs.title: CLIPTextEncode — CLIP Text Encode
docs.text:
Turn a prompt string into CONDITIONING for the sampler.

Lab notes

The dim CLIP box after Queue is this string. Prompt Enhance nodes rewrite it when Enhance is on.

Socket Dir Type What it carries clip in CLIP Matching family encoder. text in STRING Often wired from Prompt Enhance so the widget is a preview. CONDITIONING out CONDITIONING Positive or negative cond.

docs.title: text

## shorts/night-oven/act-03

LTX canvas 1280x704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid).

The stitched MP4 is written automatically to `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}` (container `/outputs`) as a faststart H.264 master, plus an HTML sidecar. After Queue, a **Film ready** overlay offers play and download. Per-shot VHS nodes remain for inspection. Optional board: studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

One-click 90s unit (overnight bakery · Gold loaves): Klein identity still + 18 sequential LTX 5.00s AV prints + in-graph stitch.
Models: Klein 4B distilled FP8 (identity still, 4-step, Enhance **off**, t2i mode) · LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot + gemma4 CLIP ltxv + video/audio VAEs (print).
LTX Community License — not Apache. $10M company-revenue cap. Disclose AI-generated media; do not strip provenance; do not distill.

1. Queue **once**. Klein runs first; models unload; then 18 × 5.00s LTX prints chain last-frame → next start.
2. Wall-clock is 18 sequential 5s prints (tens of minutes to a couple of hours on GB10) — expected, not a hang.
3. The MP4 is already on disk at `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_nightoven_90s.mp4` (act graphs write `ez_nightoven_actN_90s.mp4`). A **Film ready** overlay plays it. Copy off the Spark with scp.
4. Optional single-shot iterate: **ltx/still-to-shot**. Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**.
5. Spark-farm / host stitch fallback: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes`

Do not Queue a 90s denoise (keep 121-frame / 1+8n widgets). US-safe local pack only. No score.
Prompt enhance is **off** so the pinned identity and each baked LTX I2V paragraph are encoded as written. The identity STRING is wired into each shot enhance as context (used only if you turn Enhance on).

This graph is **act 3/5** of a 7.5 min film (90 × 5.00s). Act 3 LoadImage should be the previous act last frame (ez_nightoven_b12_s3_last_*.png). In-graph stitch writes `ez_nightoven_act3_90s.mp4`. After all five acts: `concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes` → `ez_nightoven_450s.mp4`.

Occupancy: film — stop everything else on that Spark. One GB10 job.

This graph: ## night-oven (overnight bakery · Gold loaves) Queue **once**. Klein identity still → 18 × 5.00s LTX AV prints (last-frame continuity) → **Save 90s film (MP4)**. Do not Queue a 90s denoise (121 frame…

## night-oven (overnight bakery · Gold loaves)

Queue **once**. Klein identity still → 18 × 5.00s LTX AV prints (last-frame continuity) → **Save 90s film (MP4)**. Do not Queue a 90s denoise (121 frames = 1+8n per shot). Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**. Optional host stitch: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes`.

18 × 121 frames @ 24 fps (LTX 1+8n) stitch under a 90.00s cap. US-safe local pack only. No score. Play/download: overlay, `ez_*_90s.html`, or studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

**Identity look:** A photoreal third-person bakery still at 2 a.m. A flour-dusted linen apron hangs on a steel bench in the foreground, unmarked mixer bowls and a dark oven mouth behind. Warm tungsten versus a sodium alley through one high window. Match a standing eyeline. 35mm-equivalent classic, framed for YouTube 16:9, empty of lettering, mild film grain, clean unmarked lens.

| Beat | Place | s1 | s2 | s3 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Pale sodium | Night thinning | The mixer is washed | A cloth on the bench |
| 2 | Wash | Water on steel | A wring of the cloth | The apron is untied |
| 3 | Untie | The apron returns to the hook | It hangs | The oven is dark again |
| 4 | Dark mouth | The bakery is almost still | A last look at the loaf | The window goes towards dawn |
| 5 | Blue window | Tungsten loses to blue | The loaf sits | Hands do not take it |
| 6 | Untouched | The apron on the hook | Flour on the floor | A broom somewhere off |
Prompt enhance is **off** so authored text (recipe, script labels, ACE tags, or film shots) is encoded as written. Turn Enhance on only if you want the 4B rewriter.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy film. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## shorts/night-oven/act-04

LTX canvas 1280x704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid).

The stitched MP4 is written automatically to `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}` (container `/outputs`) as a faststart H.264 master, plus an HTML sidecar. After Queue, a **Film ready** overlay offers play and download. Per-shot VHS nodes remain for inspection. Optional board: studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

One-click 90s unit (overnight bakery · Alley dawn): Klein identity still + 18 sequential LTX 5.00s AV prints + in-graph stitch.
Models: Klein 4B distilled FP8 (identity still, 4-step, Enhance **off**, t2i mode) · LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot + gemma4 CLIP ltxv + video/audio VAEs (print).
LTX Community License — not Apache. $10M company-revenue cap. Disclose AI-generated media; do not strip provenance; do not distill.

1. Queue **once**. Klein runs first; models unload; then 18 × 5.00s LTX prints chain last-frame → next start.
2. Wall-clock is 18 sequential 5s prints (tens of minutes to a couple of hours on GB10) — expected, not a hang.
3. The MP4 is already on disk at `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_nightoven_90s.mp4` (act graphs write `ez_nightoven_actN_90s.mp4`). A **Film ready** overlay plays it. Copy off the Spark with scp.
4. Optional single-shot iterate: **ltx/still-to-shot**. Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**.
5. Spark-farm / host stitch fallback: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes`

Do not Queue a 90s denoise (keep 121-frame / 1+8n widgets). US-safe local pack only. No score.
Prompt enhance is **off** so the pinned identity and each baked LTX I2V paragraph are encoded as written. The identity STRING is wired into each shot enhance as context (used only if you turn Enhance on).

This graph is **act 4/5** of a 7.5 min film (90 × 5.00s). Act 4 LoadImage should be the previous act last frame (ez_nightoven_b18_s3_last_*.png). In-graph stitch writes `ez_nightoven_act4_90s.mp4`. After all five acts: `concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes` → `ez_nightoven_450s.mp4`.

Occupancy: film — stop everything else on that Spark. One GB10 job.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load shorts/night-oven/act-04 from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph (all 19 instances): euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

## shorts/night-oven/act-04

LTX canvas 1280x704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid).

The stitched MP4 is written automatically to `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}` (container `/outputs`) as a faststart H.264 master, plus an HTML sidecar. After Queue, a **Film ready** overlay offers play and download. Per-shot VHS nodes remain for inspection. Optional board: studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

One-click 90s unit (overnight bakery · Alley dawn): Klein identity still + 18 sequential LTX 5.00s AV prints + in-graph stitch.
Models: Klein 4B distilled FP8 (identity still, 4-step, Enhance **off**, t2i mode) · LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot + gemma4 CLIP ltxv + video/audio VAEs (print).
LTX Community License — not Apache. $10M company-revenue cap. Disclose AI-generated media; do not strip provenance; do not distill.

1. Queue **once**. Klein runs first; models unload; then 18 × 5.00s LTX prints chain last-frame → next start.
2. Wall-clock is 18 sequential 5s prints (tens of minutes to a couple of hours on GB10) — expected, not a hang.
3. The MP4 is already on disk at `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_nightoven_90s.mp4` (act graphs write `ez_nightoven_actN_90s.mp4`). A **Film ready** overlay plays it. Copy off the Spark with scp.
4. Optional single-shot iterate: **ltx/still-to-shot**. Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**.
5. Spark-farm / host stitch fallback: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes`

Do not Queue a 90s denoise (keep 121-frame / 1+8n widgets). US-safe local pack only. No score.
Prompt enhance is **off** so the pinned identity and each baked LTX I2V paragraph are encoded as written. The identity STRING is wired into each shot enhance as context (used only if you turn Enhance on).

This graph is **act 4/5** of a 7.5 min film (90 × 5.00s). Act 4 LoadImage should be the previous act last frame (ez_nightoven_b18_s3_last_*.png). In-graph stitch writes `ez_nightoven_act4_90s.mp4`. After all five acts: `concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes` → `ez_nightoven_450s.mp4`.

Occupancy: film — stop everything else on that Spark. One GB10 job.

Markdown body.

How it affects generation: Does not affect pixels. 90s films put the beat table here.

This graph: ## night-oven (overnight bakery · Alley dawn) Queue **once**. Klein identity still → 18 × 5.00s LTX AV prints (last-frame continuity) → **Save 90s film (MP4)**. Do not Queue a 90s denoise (121 frames…

## night-oven (overnight bakery · Alley dawn)

Queue **once**. Klein identity still → 18 × 5.00s LTX AV prints (last-frame continuity) → **Save 90s film (MP4)**. Do not Queue a 90s denoise (121 frames = 1+8n per shot). Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**. Optional host stitch: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes`.

18 × 121 frames @ 24 fps (LTX 1+8n) stitch under a 90.00s cap. US-safe local pack only. No score. Play/download: overlay, `ez_*_90s.html`, or studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

**Identity look:** A photoreal third-person bakery still at 2 a.m. A flour-dusted linen apron hangs on a steel bench in the foreground, unmarked mixer bowls and a dark oven mouth behind. Warm tungsten versus a sodium alley through one high window. Match a standing eyeline. 35mm-equivalent classic, framed for YouTube 16:9, empty of lettering, mild film grain, clean unmarked lens.

| Beat | Place | s1 | s2 | s3 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Path | The path to the door | The door is unmarked | A pause at the door |
| 2 | Door | The door opens on the alley | Steam of cold in the alley | The bakery stays behind |
| 3 | Alley | Wet asphalt, unmarked | A look back at the window | The window holds the apron |
| 4 | Window | The apron is a pale square | A hold | Dawn lifts the sodium |
| 5 | Dawn | The alley goes grey | No signage | The bakery window cools |
| 6 | Cool glass | The loaf is a silhouette | The apron still hangs | A last tungsten click |
Prompt enhance is **off** so authored text (recipe, script labels, ACE tags, or film shots) is encoded as written. Turn Enhance on only if you want the 4B rewriter.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy film. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## shorts/night-oven/act-05

LTX canvas 1280x704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid).

The stitched MP4 is written automatically to `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}` (container `/outputs`) as a faststart H.264 master, plus an HTML sidecar. After Queue, a **Film ready** overlay offers play and download. Per-shot VHS nodes remain for inspection. Optional board: studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

One-click 90s unit (overnight bakery · Lights out): Klein identity still + 18 sequential LTX 5.00s AV prints + in-graph stitch.
Models: Klein 4B distilled FP8 (identity still, 4-step, Enhance **off**, t2i mode) · LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot + gemma4 CLIP ltxv + video/audio VAEs (print).
LTX Community License — not Apache. $10M company-revenue cap. Disclose AI-generated media; do not strip provenance; do not distill.

1. Queue **once**. Klein runs first; models unload; then 18 × 5.00s LTX prints chain last-frame → next start.
2. Wall-clock is 18 sequential 5s prints (tens of minutes to a couple of hours on GB10) — expected, not a hang.
3. The MP4 is already on disk at `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_nightoven_90s.mp4` (act graphs write `ez_nightoven_actN_90s.mp4`). A **Film ready** overlay plays it. Copy off the Spark with scp.
4. Optional single-shot iterate: **ltx/still-to-shot**. Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**.
5. Spark-farm / host stitch fallback: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes`

Do not Queue a 90s denoise (keep 121-frame / 1+8n widgets). US-safe local pack only. No score.
Prompt enhance is **off** so the pinned identity and each baked LTX I2V paragraph are encoded as written. The identity STRING is wired into each shot enhance as context (used only if you turn Enhance on).

This graph is **act 5/5** of a 7.5 min film (90 × 5.00s). Act 5 LoadImage should be the previous act last frame (ez_nightoven_b24_s3_last_*.png). In-graph stitch writes `ez_nightoven_act5_90s.mp4`. After all five acts: `concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes` → `ez_nightoven_450s.mp4`.

Occupancy: film — stop everything else on that Spark. One GB10 job.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load shorts/night-oven/act-05 from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: UNETLoader — Load Diffusion Model
docs.text:
Load a standalone transformer/UNET from diffusion_models/.

Lab notes

Lab files: flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors, wan2.2_ti2v_5B_fp16.safetensors, ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors. weight_dtype stays default.

Socket Dir Type What it carries MODEL out MODEL Denoiser weights.

docs.text:
Type STRING.

Checkpoint filename under MODELS_DIR diffusion_models.

How it affects generation: Wrong family = Queue error or a melted picture. Do not swap Klein 9B / FLUX.2-dev / MiniMax.

docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: default.

How it affects generation: default keeps the file's dtype (Klein FP8, LTX INT8-convrot, Wan FP16).

docs.text:

docs.text:

Lab notes

docs.text:

Latent pixel width.

docs.text:

Latent pixel height.

How many stills in one Queue.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

Instance Value KSampler 42 KSampler 114 KSampler 115 KSampler 116 KSampler 117 KSampler 118 KSampler 119 KSampler 120 KSampler 121 KSampler 122 KSampler 123 KSampler 124 KSampler 125 KSampler 126 KSampler 127 KSampler 128 KSampler 129 KSampler 130 KSampler 131

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph (all 19 instances): fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

Instance Value KSampler 4 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20 KSampler 20

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph (all 19 instances): 1.0

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph (all 19 instances): euler

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

## shorts/night-oven/act-05

LTX canvas 1280x704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid).

The stitched MP4 is written automatically to `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}` (container `/outputs`) as a faststart H.264 master, plus an HTML sidecar. After Queue, a **Film ready** overlay offers play and download. Per-shot VHS nodes remain for inspection. Optional board: studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

One-click 90s unit (overnight bakery · Lights out): Klein identity still + 18 sequential LTX 5.00s AV prints + in-graph stitch.
Models: Klein 4B distilled FP8 (identity still, 4-step, Enhance **off**, t2i mode) · LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot + gemma4 CLIP ltxv + video/audio VAEs (print).
LTX Community License — not Apache. $10M company-revenue cap. Disclose AI-generated media; do not strip provenance; do not distill.

1. Queue **once**. Klein runs first; models unload; then 18 × 5.00s LTX prints chain last-frame → next start.
2. Wall-clock is 18 sequential 5s prints (tens of minutes to a couple of hours on GB10) — expected, not a hang.
3. The MP4 is already on disk at `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_nightoven_90s.mp4` (act graphs write `ez_nightoven_actN_90s.mp4`). A **Film ready** overlay plays it. Copy off the Spark with scp.
4. Optional single-shot iterate: **ltx/still-to-shot**. Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**.
5. Spark-farm / host stitch fallback: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes`

Do not Queue a 90s denoise (keep 121-frame / 1+8n widgets). US-safe local pack only. No score.
Prompt enhance is **off** so the pinned identity and each baked LTX I2V paragraph are encoded as written. The identity STRING is wired into each shot enhance as context (used only if you turn Enhance on).

This graph is **act 5/5** of a 7.5 min film (90 × 5.00s). Act 5 LoadImage should be the previous act last frame (ez_nightoven_b24_s3_last_*.png). In-graph stitch writes `ez_nightoven_act5_90s.mp4`. After all five acts: `concat-shots.sh --film night-oven --yes` → `ez_nightoven_450s.mp4`.

Occupancy: film — stop everything else on that Spark. One GB10 job.

## night-oven (overnight bakery · Lights out)

Queue **once**. Klein identity still → 18 × 5.00s LTX AV prints (last-frame continuity) → **Save 90s film (MP4)**. Do not Queue a 90s denoise (121 frames = 1+8n per shot). **Identity look:** A photoreal third-person bakery still at 2 a.m. A flour-dusted linen apron hangs on a steel bench in the foreground, unmarked mixer bowls and a dark oven mouth behind. Warm tungsten versus a sodium alley through one high window. Match a standing eyeline. 35mm-equivalent classic, framed for YouTube 16:9, empty of lettering, mild film grain, clean unmarked lens.

| Beat | Place | s1 | s2 | s3 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Dark shop | Lights out | The apron in the dark | A hold on the hook |
| 2 | Hook | The hook is a black mark | Flour dust settles | The bench is empty |
| 3 | Empty bench | Steel and night | The mixer is a shape | The oven mouth is black |
| 4 | Black mouth | No fire | A last steam ghost | The ghost dies |
| 5 | Still air | The unmarked bakery waits | The apron waits | The camera holds |
| 6 | Close | Dawn at the high window only | The apron in first grey | The frame holds the apron on steel |

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy film. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## shorts/tide-table/act-01

LTX canvas 1280x704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid).

The stitched MP4 is written automatically to `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}` (container `/outputs`) as a faststart H.264 master, plus an HTML sidecar. After Queue, a **Film ready** overlay offers play and download. Per-shot VHS nodes remain for inspection. Optional board: studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

One-click 90s unit (dawn skiff · Launch from the hard): Klein identity still + 18 sequential LTX 5.00s AV prints + in-graph stitch.
Models: Klein 4B distilled FP8 (identity still, 4-step, Enhance **off**, t2i mode) · LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot + gemma4 CLIP ltxv + video/audio VAEs (print).
LTX Community License — not Apache. $10M company-revenue cap. Disclose AI-generated media; do not strip provenance; do not distill.

1. Queue **once**. Klein runs first; models unload; then 18 × 5.00s LTX prints chain last-frame → next start.
2. Wall-clock is 18 sequential 5s prints (tens of minutes to a couple of hours on GB10) — expected, not a hang.
3. The MP4 is already on disk at `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_tidetable_90s.mp4` (act graphs write `ez_tidetable_actN_90s.mp4`). A **Film ready** overlay plays it. Copy off the Spark with scp.
4. Optional single-shot iterate: **ltx/still-to-shot**. Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**.
5. Spark-farm / host stitch fallback: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film tide-table --yes`

Do not Queue a 90s denoise (keep 121-frame / 1+8n widgets). US-safe local pack only. No score.
Prompt enhance is **off** so the pinned identity and each baked LTX I2V paragraph are encoded as written. The identity STRING is wired into each shot enhance as context (used only if you turn Enhance on).

This graph is **act 1/5** of a 7.5 min film (90 × 5.00s). Act 1 starts from Klein identity. In-graph stitch writes `ez_tidetable_act1_90s.mp4`. After all five acts: `concat-shots.sh --film tide-table --yes` → `ez_tidetable_450s.mp4`.

Occupancy: film — stop everything else on that Spark. One GB10 job.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load shorts/tide-table/act-01 from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: Node parameter reference
docs.text: Every unique node type on this graph. Widgets are in lab JSON order. Choices are ComfyUI v0.34.6 / lab INPUT_TYPES — not SD1.5 folklore.

docs.title: UNETLoader — Load Diffusion Model
docs.text:
Load a standalone transformer/UNET from diffusion_models/.

Lab notes

Lab files: flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors, wan2.2_ti2v_5B_fp16.safetensors, ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors. weight_dtype stays default.

Socket Dir Type What it carries MODEL out MODEL Denoiser weights.

docs.title: unet_name
docs.text:
Type STRING.

Checkpoint filename under MODELS_DIR diffusion_models.

How it affects generation: Wrong family = Queue error or a melted picture. Do not swap Klein 9B / FLUX.2-dev / MiniMax.

Instance Value Klein 4B distilled FP8 flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors

docs.title: weight_dtype
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: default.

Cast at load.

How it affects generation: default keeps the file's dtype (Klein FP8, LTX INT8-convrot, Wan FP16).

This graph (all 2 instances): default

Other choices

Choice What it does default Load weights as stored. Lab UNETLoader always uses this. fp8_e4m3fn Cast to FP8 e4m3fn. Can save memory; may shift Klein/LTX quality. fp8_e4m3fn_fast FP8 e4m3fn with fast optimizations. fp8_e5m2 Cast to FP8 e5m2.

docs.title: CLIPLoader — Load CLIP
docs.text:
Load a text encoder. The type combo must match the UNET family.

Lab notes

Lab types: flux2 (Qwen3-4B), wan (UMT5), ltxv (Gemma4-with-proj). Wrong type is a Queue error, not a bad prompt. MiniMax type is banned.

Socket Dir Type What it carries CLIP out CLIP Text encoder for CLIPTextEncode / ACE / LTX.

docs.title: clip_name
docs.text:
Type STRING.

Filename under text_encoders.

How it affects generation: Must match the family (qwen_3_4b, umt5_xxl, gemma4-12b-with-proj).

Instance Value Qwen3-4B TE qwen_3_4b.safetensors Gemma4-with-proj (ltxv) gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors

docs.title: type
docs.text:
Type COMBO.

CLIPType enum. Picks tokenizer + template.

How it affects generation: flux2 wraps Klein strings in a Qwen chat template — do not paste <|im_start|>. wan is UMT5. ltxv is Gemma4-with-proj.

Instance Value Qwen3-4B TE flux2 Gemma4-with-proj (ltxv) ltxv

Other choices

Choice What it does flux2 Klein 4B / Qwen3-4B text encoder. Lab stills. wan Wan 2.2 UMT5-XXL. Lab silent motion. ltxv LTX-2.5 Gemma4-with-proj. Lab AV. ace ACE-Step text encoder. Music graphs use CheckpointLoaderSimple instead. stable_diffusion SD1.x CLIP. Not a lab default. stable_cascade Stable Cascade CLIP. sd3 SD3 CLIP stack. stable_audio Stable Audio T5. mochi Mochi T5. pixart PixArt. cosmos Cosmos T5. lumina2 Lumina-2 Gemma. hidream HiDream. chroma Chroma. omnigen2 OmniGen2. qwen_image Qwen-Image. hunyuan_image Hunyuan image. ovis Ovis. longcat_image LongCat image. Optional stub only. cogvideox CogVideoX T5. lens Lens. pixeldit PixelDit. ideogram4 Ideogram. boogu Boogu. krea2 Krea. joyimage JoyImage Qwen3-VL. mage Mage. minimax MiniMax. Banned in this studio (US Excluded Territory). Do not pick.

docs.title: device
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: default.

Where to load the encoder.

How it affects generation: default uses GPU. cpu is a debug escape hatch.

This graph (all 2 instances): default

Other choices

Choice What it does default Load on the Comfy compute device (GPU). Lab default. cpu Force CPU. Much slower; only for debugging a CLIP load.

docs.title: VAELoader — Load VAE
docs.text:
Load the autoencoder that maps pixels ↔ latents (and LTX audio).

Lab notes

Do not mix families: flux2-vae, wan2.2_vae, ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16, ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.

Socket Dir Type What it carries VAE out VAE Encoder/decoder.

docs.text:

Filename under vae/.

How it affects generation: Wrong VAE = color trash or a shape error.

docs.title: CLIPTextEncode — CLIP Text Encode
docs.text:
Turn a prompt string into CONDITIONING for the sampler.

Lab notes

The dim CLIP box after Queue is this string. Prompt Enhance nodes rewrite it when Enhance is on.

Socket Dir Type What it carries clip in CLIP Matching family encoder. text in STRING Often wired from Prompt Enhance so the widget is a preview. CONDITIONING out CONDITIONING Positive or negative cond.

docs.title: text
docs.text:
Type STRING.

Prompt encoded by CLIP.

How it affects generation: Klein: sentences, subject → place → light → camera. Wan I2V: motion + one camera only. LTX: present-tense paragraph with audio interleaved. Distilled Klein quality lives here, not in CFG.

Instance Value Positive A photoreal third-person dawn still. ## shorts/tide-table/act-01

LTX canvas 1280x704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid).

The stitched MP4 is written automatically to `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}` (container `/outputs`) as a faststart H.264 master, plus an HTML sidecar. After Queue, a **Film ready** overlay offers play and download. Per-shot VHS nodes remain for inspection. Optional board: studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

One-click 90s unit (dawn skiff · Launch from the hard): Klein identity still + 18 sequential LTX 5.00s AV prints + in-graph stitch.
Models: Klein 4B distilled FP8 (identity still, 4-step, Enhance **off**, t2i mode) · LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot + gemma4 CLIP ltxv + video/audio VAEs (print).
LTX Community License — not Apache. $10M company-revenue cap. Disclose AI-generated media; do not strip provenance; do not distill.

1. Queue **once**. Klein runs first; models unload; then 18 × 5.00s LTX prints chain last-frame → next start.
2. Wall-clock is 18 sequential 5s prints (tens of minutes to a couple of hours on GB10) — expected, not a hang.
3. The MP4 is already on disk at `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_tidetable_90s.mp4` (act graphs write `ez_tidetable_actN_90s.mp4`). A **Film ready** overlay plays it. Copy off the Spark with scp.
4. Optional single-shot iterate: **ltx/still-to-shot**. Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**.
5. Spark-farm / host stitch fallback: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film tide-table --yes`

Do not Queue a 90s denoise (keep 121-frame / 1+8n widgets). US-safe local pack only. No score.
Prompt enhance is **off** so the pinned identity and each baked LTX I2V paragraph are encoded as written. The identity STRING is wired into each shot enhance as context (used only if you turn Enhance on).

This graph is **act 1/5** of a 7.5 min film (90 × 5.00s). Act 1 starts from Klein identity. In-graph stitch writes `ez_tidetable_act1_90s.mp4`. After all five acts: `concat-shots.sh --film tide-table --yes` → `ez_tidetable_450s.mp4`.

Occupancy: film — stop everything else on that Spark. One GB10 job.

This graph: ## tide-table (dawn skiff · Launch from the hard) Queue **once**. Klein identity still → 18 × 5.00s LTX AV prints (last-frame continuity) → **Save 90s film (MP4)**. Do not Queue a 90s denoise (121 fr…

## tide-table (dawn skiff · Launch from the hard)

Queue **once**. Klein identity still → 18 × 5.00s LTX AV prints (last-frame continuity) → **Save 90s film (MP4)**. Do not Queue a 90s denoise (121 frames = 1+8n per shot). Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**. Optional host stitch: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film tide-table --yes`.

18 × 121 frames @ 24 fps (LTX 1+8n) stitch under a 90.00s cap. US-safe local pack only. No score. Play/download: overlay, `ez_*_90s.html`, or studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

**Identity look:** A photoreal third-person dawn still. A weathered unmarked wooden skiff bow fills the lower third, wet grain and a blank painter coil on the thwart, looking out from a stone hard toward a cut of unmarked piles and grey-pink water. Match a standing eyeline. 35mm-equivalent classic, framed for YouTube 16:9, empty of lettering, mild film grain, clean unmarked lens.

| Beat | Place | s1 | s2 | s3 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | The hard | Hands untie the painter from a wet ring | The skiff is pushed off the stone | The bow clears the last pile |
| 2 | The cut | The skiff noses into slack water | Oarlocks creak on a slow pull | The bow aims at a dark pool |
| 3 | First pool | The hull kisses a rock shelf | A look down into unmarked weed | The bow slides along the shelf |
| 4 | Shelf walk | The skiff tracks the wet granite | A drip from the gunwale | The bow enters the slot |
| 5 | Fog edge | Mist takes the far piles | The bow holds a compass heading | The spar slides past |
| 6 | Lost shore | The hard vanishes astern | A slow pull in the fog | The bow finds a wider pool |
Prompt enhance is **off** so authored text (recipe, script labels, ACE tags, or film shots) is encoded as written. Turn Enhance on only if you want the 4B rewriter.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy film. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## shorts/tide-table/act-02

LTX canvas 1280x704 (width/height must be divisible by 32; 720 and 1080 are invalid).

The stitched MP4 is written automatically to `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}` (container `/outputs`) as a faststart H.264 master, plus an HTML sidecar. After Queue, a **Film ready** overlay offers play and download. Per-shot VHS nodes remain for inspection. Optional board: studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

One-click 90s unit (dawn skiff · Tide tables): Klein identity still + 18 sequential LTX 5.00s AV prints + in-graph stitch.
Models: Klein 4B distilled FP8 (identity still, 4-step, Enhance **off**, t2i mode) · LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot + gemma4 CLIP ltxv + video/audio VAEs (print).
LTX Community License — not Apache. $10M company-revenue cap. Disclose AI-generated media; do not strip provenance; do not distill.

1. Queue **once**. Klein runs first; models unload; then 18 × 5.00s LTX prints chain last-frame → next start.
2. Wall-clock is 18 sequential 5s prints (tens of minutes to a couple of hours on GB10) — expected, not a hang.
3. The MP4 is already on disk at `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_tidetable_90s.mp4` (act graphs write `ez_tidetable_actN_90s.mp4`). A **Film ready** overlay plays it. Copy off the Spark with scp.
4. Optional single-shot iterate: **ltx/still-to-shot**. Optional silent rehearsal: **wan/still-to-shot**.
5. Spark-farm / host stitch fallback: `./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --film tide-table --yes`

Do not Queue a 90s denoise (keep 121-frame / 1+8n widgets). US-safe local pack only. No score.
Prompt enhance is **off** so the pinned identity and each baked LTX I2V paragraph are encoded as written. The identity STRING is wired into each shot enhance as context (used only if you turn Enhance on).

This graph is **act 2/5** of a 7.5 min film (90 × 5.00s). Act 2 LoadImage should be the previous act last frame (ez_tidetable_b6_s3_last_*.png). In-graph stitch writes `ez_tidetable_act2_90s.mp4`. After all five acts: `concat-shots.sh --film tide-table --yes` → `ez_tidetable_450s.mp4`.

Occupancy: film — stop everything else on that Spark. One GB10 job.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load shorts/tide-table/act-02 from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.
