docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

Occupancy wan. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## wan/sticker-loop

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load wan/sticker-loop from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 20

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 5

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: uni_pc

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

How it affects generation: 1.0 is full generation (T2I / T2V / ACE). Values below 1 keep structure from an encoded start image (Klein edit / clay). Lab I2V uses dedicated latent nodes, not denoise<1 on empty noise.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy wan. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## wan/still-to-shot

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview** for an inline preview. File lands on the host at `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_*_*.mp4` (container `/outputs`). Save frames PNG is secondary.

US-safe 5.00s silent I2V shot (120 frames @ 24 fps) with last-frame SaveImage.
Models: wan2.2_ti2v_5B_fp16 + umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled (CLIP wan) + wan2.2_vae. Apache 2.0. Silent.

90s films: optional silent rehearsal. Copy `wan_i2v` from `{film}.shots.yaml`, set LoadImage to the previous last PNG, VHS prefix ez_<slug>_bN_sM_wan_video. Prefer the one-click **film-*-90s** LTX path for the deliverable.

Six-shot concat demo: Queue this six times with VHS prefix ez_shot_01 .. ez_shot_06, then ./scripts/utilities/concat-shots.sh --yes

Do not Queue a 90s denoise. US-safe local pack only. No score.
90s films: prefer the one-click **shorts/go-see** graphs (Queue once). This graph remains the silent 5.00s rehearsal.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

Occupancy: wan — stop LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
90s films: prefer the one-click **shorts/go-see** graphs (Queue once: identity + 18 LTX prints + stitch). This graph remains the generic 5.00s printer / spark-farm shot / Wan rehearsal.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 20

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 5

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: uni_pc

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy wan. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## wan/still-to-video-5s

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview** for an inline preview. File lands on the host at `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_*_*.mp4` (container `/outputs`). Save frames PNG is secondary.

Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B Apache 2.0 silent I2V smoke (~5 s @ 24 fps).
Models: wan2.2_ti2v_5B_fp16.safetensors + umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors (CLIP type wan) + wan2.2_vae.safetensors.
Widgets: seed 42 fixed · 121 frames · 832x480 · 24 fps.

LoadImage default example.png. After a still, set ez_still_draft_*.png or ez_still_hero_*.png.
Edit Motion / prompt only. PRIMARY OUTPUT: VHS_VideoCombine MP4 24 fps.

This graph is a smoke/demo (121 frames). For 90s films or ez_shot_01..06 concat, use wan/still-to-shot (120 frames + last frame).
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

Occupancy: wan — stop LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 20

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 5

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: uni_pc

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: wan/text-to-video-5s
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded wan/text-to-video-5s from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/wan/text-to-video-5s.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy wan. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## wan/text-to-video-5s

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview** for an inline preview. File lands on the host at `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_*_*.mp4` (container `/outputs`). Save frames PNG is secondary.

Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B Apache 2.0 silent T2V smoke (~5 s @ 24 fps).
Models: wan2.2_ti2v_5B_fp16.safetensors + umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors (CLIP type wan) + wan2.2_vae.safetensors.
Widgets: seed 42 fixed · 121 frames · 832x480 · 24 fps.

LoadImage is bypassed. Edit Motion / prompt. PRIMARY OUTPUT: VHS_VideoCombine MP4 24 fps.
No native audio. For I2V from a still, use wan/still-to-video-5s.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

Occupancy: wan — stop LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load wan/text-to-video-5s from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 20

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 5

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: uni_pc

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

How it affects generation: 1.0 is full generation (T2I / T2V / ACE). Values below 1 keep structure from an encoded start image (Klein edit / clay). Lab I2V uses dedicated latent nodes, not denoise<1 on empty noise.

docs.title: wan/vace-join
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded wan/vace-join from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/wan/vace-join.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy wan. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## wan/vace-join

Opt-in Wan 2.1 VACE 1.3B Apache join smoke. Not download-models.
Download: ./scripts/utilities/download-wan.sh run --tier vace
Unload LTX first. MagCache is off (never on this graph).
Frame count is 17 (1+8n, inside 16–24). Even latents crash.
Models: diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors (VACE 1.3B) + umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors (CLIP type wan) + wan2.2_vae.safetensors.
Load Shot A last frame and Shot B first frame. Native WanVaceToVideo is the intended join when the Comfy pin exposes it; this graph Queues on core Wan22ImageToVideoLatent so the canvas loads without a missing-node error.
PRIMARY OUTPUT: VHS_VideoCombine MP4 24 fps. Prefix ez_vace_join.
Do not coreside with TRELLIS, Fun InP, SeedVR2, or LTX.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.

Occupancy: wan — stop LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load wan/vace-join from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 20

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 5

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: uni_pc

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: denoise
docs.text:

Fraction of the latent to replace with denoised signal.

How it affects generation: 1.0 is full generation (T2I / T2V / ACE). Values below 1 keep structure from an encoded start image (Klein edit / clay). Lab I2V uses dedicated latent nodes, not denoise<1 on empty noise.

What's on this page

Generated from workflows/_lab/wan/creator/candle-loop.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy wan. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## wan/creator/candle-loop

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Silent candle-flicker loop. Lab size **832×480**. Prefix `ez_candle`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: wan — stop LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview**. File lands on `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
LoadImage defaults to example.png so Queue smokes.
Prompt enhance is **off** so authored text (recipe, script labels, ACE tags, or film shots) is encoded as written. Turn Enhance on only if you want the 4B rewriter.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load wan/creator/candle-loop from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 20

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 5

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: uni_pc

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

How it affects generation: 1.0 is full generation (T2I / T2V / ACE). Values below 1 keep structure from an encoded start image (Klein edit / clay). Lab I2V uses dedicated latent nodes, not denoise<1 on empty noise.

What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded wan/creator/confetti-loop from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/wan/creator/confetti-loop.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy wan. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## wan/creator/confetti-loop

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Silent celebration loop. Lab size **832×480**. Prefix `ez_confetti`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: wan — stop LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview**. File lands on `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
LoadImage defaults to example.png so Queue smokes.
Prompt enhance is **off** so authored text (recipe, script labels, ACE tags, or film shots) is encoded as written. Turn Enhance on only if you want the 4B rewriter.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load wan/creator/confetti-loop from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.text:

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 20

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 5

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: uni_pc

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: UNETLoader — Load Diffusion Model
docs.text:

Lab notes

docs.text:

How it affects generation: flux2 wraps Klein strings in a Qwen chat template — do not paste <|im_start|>. wan is UMT5. ltxv is Gemma4-with-proj.

Other choices

Choice What it does flux2 Klein 4B / Qwen3-4B text encoder. Lab stills. wan Wan 2.2 UMT5-XXL. Lab silent motion. ltxv LTX-2.5 Gemma4-with-proj. Lab AV. ace ACE-Step text encoder. Music graphs use CheckpointLoaderSimple instead. stable_diffusion SD1.x CLIP. Not a lab default. stable_cascade Stable Cascade CLIP. sd3 SD3 CLIP stack. stable_audio Stable Audio T5. mochi Mochi T5. pixart PixArt. cosmos Cosmos T5. lumina2 Lumina-2 Gemma. hidream HiDream. chroma Chroma. omnigen2 OmniGen2. qwen_image Qwen-Image. hunyuan_image Hunyuan image. ovis Ovis. longcat_image LongCat image. docs.title: text
docs.text:
Type STRING.

Prompt encoded by CLIP.

How it affects generation: Klein: sentences, subject → place → light → camera. Wan I2V: motion + one camera only. LTX: present-tense paragraph with audio interleaved. Distilled Klein quality lives here, not in CFG.

Instance Value Motion / prompt A warm breeze moves coat hem and hair. Locked camera otherwise. Keep every obje… Negative morphing, identity drift, warping objects, face melting, flicker, jitter, frame…

docs.title: shift
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 8 (lab Wan).

Flow-matching shift.

How it affects generation: 8 is the Wan 2.2 TI2V lab value. Changing it moves the noise schedule; do not copy SD3 defaults blindly.

This graph: 8

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 20

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 5

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: uni_pc

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: denoise
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–1; lab 1.0.

Fraction of the latent to replace with denoised signal.

How it affects generation: 1.0 is full generation (T2I / T2V / ACE). Values below 1 keep structure from an encoded start image (Klein edit / clay). Lab I2V uses dedicated latent nodes, not denoise<1 on empty noise.

This graph: 1

Lab notes

Every lab graph has one. Purpose, models, sampler, occupancy, run steps.

Markdown-ish operator note.

How it affects generation: Does not affect pixels. Read it before Queue.

This graph: ## wan/creator/fabric-breeze Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size. Silent fabric/hair breeze ~5 s. Lab size **832×480**. Prefixez_breeze. Empty …

## wan/creator/fabric-breeze

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Silent fabric/hair breeze ~5 s. Lab size **832×480**. Prefix `ez_breeze`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: wan — stop LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview**. File lands on `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
LoadImage defaults to example.png so Queue smokes.
Prompt enhance is **off** so authored text (recipe, script labels, ACE tags, or film shots) is encoded as written. Turn Enhance on only if you want the 4B rewriter.

docs.title: wan/creator/handheld-vlog

What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded wan/creator/handheld-vlog from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/wan/creator/handheld-vlog.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy wan. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## wan/creator/handheld-vlog

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Silent handheld vlog micro-shake 9:16. Lab size **480×832**. Prefix `ez_vlog`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: wan — stop LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview**. File lands on `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
LoadImage defaults to example.png so Queue smokes.
Prompt enhance is **off** so authored text (recipe, script labels, ACE tags, or film shots) is encoded as written. Turn Enhance on only if you want the 4B rewriter.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load wan/creator/handheld-vlog from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.text:

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 20

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 5

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: uni_pc

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent. LATENT out LATENT Denoised latent for VAE decode.

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 0 … 2^64-1; lab 42.

Random seed for the noise tensor.

How it affects generation: Same seed + same graph ≈ same picture or clip. Lab locks 42 on smokes so drafts are comparable.

This graph: 42

docs.title: control_after_generate
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: fixed (lab).

What happens to seed after Queue.

How it affects generation: fixed keeps iteration honest while you change the prompt.

This graph: fixed

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 20

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 5

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: uni_pc

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Purpose, occupancy, and models from the on-canvas Note
  • Graph flow (groups when the canvas is large)
  • Every node id on this graph
  • Node parameter reference for each type, with this graph's values and the other legal choices

What this enables

  • Queuing this filename with known widgets
  • Changing a parameter with a documented generation effect

Who this is for: studio users who loaded wan/creator/ken-burns from Apps or Workflows.

Generated from workflows/_lab/wan/creator/ken-burns.json. Do not hand-edit this file. Re-run python3 docs/generate_workflow_docs.py (or make docs).

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Occupancy wan. Outputs under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}. Unload the previous family before Queue.

## wan/creator/ken-burns

Format / platform sets pixels (Custom uses Width × Height). Quality does not change size.

Silent Ken Burns pan/zoom ~5 s. Lab size **832×480**. Prefix `ez_kenburns`.
Empty of lettering. Add titles in your editor, not in the prompt.
Occupancy: wan — stop LTX, podcast, music. One GB10 job.
Handoff: none.
After Queue, click **Save video (MP4) — open node for preview**. File lands on `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}`.
LoadImage defaults to example.png so Queue smokes.
Prompt enhance is **off** so authored text (recipe, script labels, ACE tags, or film shots) is encoded as written. Turn Enhance on only if you want the 4B rewriter.

docs.title: How to Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load wan/creator/ken-burns from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

Other choices

Choice What it does fixed Keep this seed on the next Queue. Lab default for reproducible stills and 5 s prints. increment Add 1 after Queue. Use for a sequence of variations. decrement Subtract 1 after Queue. randomize Draw a new seed after Queue. Exploration only.

docs.title: steps
docs.text:
Type INT. Range / default: 1–10000; Klein distilled 4; LTX 20; Wan 20; ACE 8; TRELLIS 12.

Denoising iterations.

How it affects generation: More steps refine detail with diminishing returns. Distilled Klein is authored at 4 — raising steps is slower, not a quality knob. Do not raise LTX/Wan toward a 90 s denoise.

This graph: 20

docs.title: cfg
docs.text:
Type FLOAT. Range / default: 0–100; Klein/LTX/ACE 1.0; Wan 5; TRELLIS 7.5.

Classifier-free guidance scale.

How it affects generation: Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 — raising CFG is the wrong quality lever (use the Positive prompt, resolution, or still-hero). Wan silent 5B uses CFG 5. TRELLIS structure uses 7.5. At CFG 1.0 Comfy skips the negative pass.

This graph: 5

docs.title: sampler_name
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: euler (most lab); uni_pc (Wan).

ODE / SDE algorithm that removes noise.

How it affects generation: euler is the lab still/AV/ACE default. uni_pc is the Wan 5B silent default. Ancestral/SDE samplers add extra randomness and weaken seed lock.

This graph: uni_pc

Other choices

Choice What it does euler First-order ODE. Lab default for Klein, LTX, ACE, and most stills. Fast and stable at CFG 1.0. euler_cfg_pp Euler with CFG++. Rarely needed on distilled Klein (CFG is already 1.0). euler_ancestral Adds ancestral noise each step. More variation; weaker exact seed lock. euler_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral Euler with CFG++. heun Second-order Heun. Slower, sometimes smoother; not a lab default. heunpp2 Higher-order Heun variant. exp_heun_2_x0 Exponential Heun (x0 prediction). exp_heun_2_x0_sde Exponential Heun SDE. Extra stochasticity. dpm_2 DPM-Solver-2. Two function evals per step. dpm_2_ancestral Ancestral DPM-2. lms Linear multistep. Older; keep for experiments only. dpm_fast Fast DPM. Coarse, good for previews. dpm_adaptive Adaptive DPM. Step count is a hint, not a hard budget. dpmpp_2s_ancestral DPM++ 2S ancestral. Common SD1.5 pick; not a Klein default. dpmpp_2s_ancestral_cfg_pp DPM++ 2S ancestral with CFG++. dpmpp_sde DPM++ SDE. Stochastic, slower. dpmpp_sde_gpu DPM++ SDE on GPU noise. dpmpp_2m DPM++ 2M. Smooth; often used on SD-family, not distilled Klein. dpmpp_2m_cfg_pp DPM++ 2M with CFG++. dpmpp_2m_sde DPM++ 2M SDE. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE GPU noise. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun DPM++ 2M SDE Heun. dpmpp_2m_sde_heun_gpu DPM++ 2M SDE Heun GPU. dpmpp_3m_sde DPM++ 3M SDE. dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu DPM++ 3M SDE GPU. ddpm Classic DDPM. Slow; do not use on 121-frame LTX. lcm Latent Consistency. Needs an LCM-tuned model; not lab Klein/Wan/LTX. ipndm iPNDM multistep. ipndm_v iPNDM (v-prediction). deis DEIS multistep. res_multistep Res multistep. Some turbo recipes. res_multistep_cfg_pp Res multistep CFG++. res_multistep_ancestral Ancestral res multistep. res_multistep_ancestral_cfg_pp Ancestral res multistep CFG++. gradient_estimation Gradient-estimation sampler. gradient_estimation_cfg_pp Gradient-estimation CFG++. er_sde ER-SDE sampler. seeds_2 SEEDS-2. seeds_3 SEEDS-3. sa_solver SA-Solver. sa_solver_pece SA-Solver PECE. ddim DDIM. Deterministic; not a lab default. uni_pc UniPC. Lab Wan 5B silent graphs use this with CFG 5. uni_pc_bh2 UniPC BH2 variant.

docs.title: scheduler
docs.text:
Type COMBO. Range / default: simple (most lab); normal (TRELLIS).

How sigmas are spaced across steps.

How it affects generation: simple is even spacing and matches distilled Klein / LTX / ACE. normal is the TRELLIS pair. Do not copy karras from an SD1.5 recipe onto Klein.

This graph: simple

Other choices

Choice What it does simple Even sigma spacing. Lab default for Klein, Wan, LTX, and ACE. normal Linear timestep schedule. TRELLIS structure/texture stages use this. karras Karras sigmas. Often sharper on SD-family; not the lab default. exponential Exponential sigma decay. sgm_uniform SGM uniform. SD3-family default; Wan uses ModelSamplingSD3 shift instead. ddim_uniform Uniform DDIM schedule. beta Beta-distribution timesteps. linear_quadratic Linear then quadratic (Mochi-style). kl_optimal KL-optimal sigma curve.

docs.title: denoise
docs.text:

Fraction of the latent to replace with denoised signal.

How it affects generation: 1.0 is full generation (T2I / T2V / ACE). Values below 1 keep structure from an encoded start image (Klein edit / clay). Lab I2V uses dedicated latent nodes, not denoise<1 on empty noise.

This graph: 1

1. ./scripts/manage.sh start so _lab is seeded
  2. Load wan/creator/light-leak-loop from Apps or Workflows
  3. Read the on-canvas Note, change widgets, Queue

Do not edit raw _lab JSON. Save keepers under _user/.

docs.title: KSampler — KSampler
docs.text:
Denoise a latent for N steps at a CFG, sampler, and scheduler.

Lab notes

Distilled Klein is CFG 1.0 / 4 steps / euler / simple. Raising CFG is not a quality knob. Wan 5B uses uni_pc and CFG 5. LTX distilled uses euler / simple / CFG 1.0 / 20 steps. ACE-Step uses 8 steps / CFG 1.0 / euler. TRELLIS uses 12 steps / CFG 7.5 / euler / normal.

Socket Dir Type What it carries model in MODEL UNET / transformer after any ModelSampling* patch. positive in CONDITIONING What to include (CLIP / ACE / LTX prompt). negative in CONDITIONING What to avoid. Distilled Klein ignores this well — put constraints in the positive. latent_image in LATENT Noise canvas or encoded start image / video / audio latent.
